An institution that operates independently of the administrative, judicial, and military branches of Huanglong, with the highest official titled "Chief Commander." Reporting directly to the Emperor of Huanglong, it holds the authority to investigate any case, official, or criminal without approval from other agencies, with the power to "act first, report later." Tasked with handling intricate cases year-round, the agency has developed specialized expertise in managing Resonators.

A special agency responsible for monitoring Sentinels, astronomy, and calendars across Huanglong's various cities. Led by the Minister of Sentinel Affairs in Mingting, it has subordinate bureaus in the other six cities, each headed by a Supervisor. While they hold independent authority on Sentinel-related matters, they are limited to advising and supervising the administrative bodies of each city and Mingting.

A unique Resonance Ability of Qiuyuan. By perceiving the nature and differences of surrounding frequencies, he can discern an enemy's location and even state of mind. In extreme cases, this perception can be amplified through Sonoro Spheres, bringing to life the mental imagery of his enemies—or even his own.

A civilization located at the polar region of Solaris. Ancient shifts in the planetary axis redefined the world's geography, turning the Lahai-Roi region into what is now the planet's pole. Over time, the vast caverns deep beneath thick layers of ice and snow gradually became habitable for humankind. In this warm and humid underground haven stands an academic metropolis for Resonators, celebrated as the "Research Haven of Solaris" and a "Utopia for Researchers."

A Tidespawn created by Leviathan. It is a fusion of the frequencies of three powerful Tacet Discords: the great lion "Nemea," the ancestral goat "Pan," and the slippery serpent "Python." Once Leviathan's "first offspring," it now "resides" within Galbrena after merging with her frequency.
Within this fused being, the lion's brutal nature dominates Chimera's will, while the goat tempers its violence by feeding on human compassion. The serpent, sly and independent, appears loyal to Galbrena but secretly undermines her frequency.
The past name of "Murmurstown." Devastated sixteen years ago by the outbreak of the Dark Tide, it is now a lost Gladiator town in the Wastelands.

The Tacet Fields that exist in isolated dimensions. 
"Tacet Fields" are thought to be where all Tacet Discords originate. These locations feature a sky of inverted seas and a deep cross-shaped Tacet Mark on the ground. Reverberations fill the air, linking our world to an unknown space through a white Resonance Cord. These areas attract gatherings of Tacet Discords.

As the highest official in Huanglong's Ministry of War, the Minister oversees all military affairs for the six cities in Huanglong. The honorific title "Grand Marshal" is used to signify the rank and authority of this position.
The capital of Huanglong. The nation's political, economic, and cultural center.

The Ministry of War is Huanglong's supreme military command, headquartered in Mingting with branches in all six cities. Its leader, the Minister of War, holds supreme command over all military affairs. Authority is delegated to a General in each city, who manages local forces. While Mingting usually appoints these Generals, local Sentinels have the authority to do so in certain special cities.

One of Huanglong's three judicial bodies. It holds the authority to jointly try major cases and wields significant supervisory power, a duty summarized as "to probe evil and maintain discipline." Its officials are generally titled Censors, while those stationed or assigned temporarily in the six cities are called Investigating Censors.

Just as the name enjoyed by Napoli the Second, it is a title Primus Fenrico should have rightfully possessed. However, due to unknown reasons, Fenrico forbade Acolytes from referring to him as such, until he met his end at the bottom of the sea. In the history of the Order of the Deep, he is the only one who bears the name "Fenrico."
A region located between Mengzhou and Jinzhou. It is considered a vital passage way between the two cities, and also once a strategic hold for intercepting Tacet Discords.

An amalgamated horror that often emerges alongside Void Storms. During lulls between Storms, it primarily inhabits the highly concentrated Voidmatter environment of the Mawburrow Desert. The Voidmatter Regulators on its head serve as both its power source and its weakness.

Officially the "Resonator Nursing Unit," the infirmary is a clinical-research hybrid facility overseen by Rabelle College.
Managed by Academy physician Luuk Herssen, it utilizes Frequency Therapeutics to provide comprehensive healthcare for the students and faculty of Startorch Academy.

An identity authentication device issued by the Spacetrek Collective, serving as mandatory safety gear for navigating Lahai-Roi.
All first-year students must complete the Cassette's burning and registration under faculty supervision at the Research Institute before venturing beyond the Academy's protected zones.

A standardized Terminal for the Spacetrek Collective members, designed to hold the Rabelle Cassette.
Its casing is constructed from a special composite that mimics the Exostrider's engineering, granting partial resistance to Void Storms.

A colossal mech of alien origin, now dormant in the Roya Frostlands. Startorch Academy was founded to train Synchronists capable of establishing Augmented Resonance with it.
In the Roya's Trine Myth, it is revered as Baldur, the earthly incarnation of the sun deity Sol. Legend claims it once held up the earth's collapsing crust with its greatsword, saving the Roya from annihilation. Predictions foretell it will awaken from its slumber to confront the ruinous Hvedrungr in a final, apocalyptic battle.

Candidates selected from across Solaris who can link their consciousness to the giant Exostrider mech via an external mechanical interface.
These Synchronists can achieve a degree of control over the Exostrider through Augmented Resonance. To identify and train these rare pilots, Startorch Academy established Rabelle College.

The Exostrider's power core and Lahai-Roi's underground "sun."
Royan records say this energy entity was removed from the Exostrider and placed underground to sustain the haven. However, monitoring data confirms a gradual but steady decline in its energy output. Both the Roya and the Spacetrek Collective are now formulating emergency contingencies in response.

A colossal vertical transport system built along the Exostrider's greatsword, connecting Lahai-Roi and the Roya Frostlands.
Its structure resembles a spine piercing both heaven and earth. Powered by orbital-acceleration technology, it connects the deep cavern to the surface and serves as Lahai-Roi's most important transportation hubs.

The Exostrider's remaining weapon. The blade is buried deep within Sundermere, while its hilt supports the very ceiling of the cavern, forming a structural pillar through the heart of Lahai-Roi.
In the Roya's Trine Myth, it is predicted that Baldur will draw this sword in the final battle against the ruinous entity Hvedrungr.

A monitoring instrument installed on the surface of Sundermere by the Spacetrek Collective to oversee and maintain the Reactor Drive.
At its core is a replica of the Exostrider's calibration module, enabling a dedicated data link with the Drive to transmit real-time correction parameters. Hyvatia plays a vital role in ensuring the Reactor Drive's continuous and stable operation.

Specialized protective infrastructure developed by Startorch Academy, using reverse-engineered materials inspired by the Exostrider's surface fibers and coatings. It provides a degree of resistance against Voidmatter contamination.
It is now deployed as a standard protective measure in Spacetrek Collective camps, research outposts, and transit hubs. The largest installation is the Antivoid Canopy surrounding Startorch Academy.

The indigenous inhabitants of Lahai-Roi. They have lived in the underground cavern long before the Spacetrek Collective's arrival. They now maintain a cooperative relationship with it.
By observing the Reactor Drive's operational cycles, the Roya devised their own calendar. They guide the growth and migration of the Exoswarm, a sacred duty they regard as their tribe's calling.

A Spacetrek Collective project decades in the making to replace the Reactor Drive in the sky with Helios, an artificial sun engineered by the Research Institute.
Its ultimate goal is to retrieve the Drive as a power source to awaken the Exostrider slumbering in the frostlands, all while keeping Lahai-Roi's ecosystem stable.

The artificial sun crafted by the Spacetrek Collective: Research Institute to replace the Reactor Drive in the New Solar Ceremony.
For successful operation, it requires environmental data from Hyvatia and raw observational data on the Reactor Drive provided by the Heliogyre.

The sacred ground of the Roya and the dwelling of the Heliodic Six. It safeguards Exostrider parts and serves as the central archive for all Royan records.
With each operational cycle of the Reactor Drive, the Solisylum calculates its stability, tracks the birth and growth of the Exoswarm, and monitors their eventual return to the Exostrider.

An artifact used exclusively by the Heliodic Six to observe the Reactor Drive.
During the New Solar Ceremony, it provides Helios with raw observational data on the Reactor Drive.

Roya elders such as the Eye, the Binder, and the Shaper. Each pair in the Six is entrusted with the roles of observation, archival, and extrapolation.
They reside within the Solisylum, tracing the Reactor Drive's trajectories and forecasting Void Storms.
The forest where the Soliskin dwell. Bathed in the light of the Reactor Drive, the woods remain untouched by the ravages of Void Storms.
Biomechanical creatures formed from the Exostrider's cellular remnants. By mimicking herds and other lifeforms, they helped rebuild Lahai-Roi's ecosystem.
Materials harvested from Exoswarm. Though still essentially parts of the Exostrider, they are widely utilized in engineering Lahai-Roi's various constructs.

Roya chosen by the Soliskin for their pure nature become Shepherds. Their duty is to guide and care for the Soliskin. They lead the Soliskin to the best sunlit areas of Bjartr Woods and keep them safe.

Individuals gifted in calendrical calculation and a degree of resonance with the Exostrider and Soliskin are permitted into the Solisylum. There, they serve the Heliodic Six as aides and the tribe as healers and teachers, all while being groomed as the Six's eventual successors.
A type of Exoswarm originating from the Exostrider's neural structures. They are believed to embody fragments of its consciousness.
Towering constructs widespread in Bjartr Woods, forming a vast, floating forest. Their roots permeate Lahai-Roi, relaying information directly to the Heliogyre.

A ceremony held by the Roya for the Soliskin. During the rite, the Soliskin transform into ethereal energy forms. Guided by Shepherds, they enter the Solistrees and disperse into luminescence as they rise.
The Roya believe this marks the Soliskin's return to the Exostrider.

A Waveworn Phenomenon unique to Lahai-Roi, erupting when Voidmatter concentrations reach a critical threshold. It indiscriminately dissolves all matter and existence within its range, causing widespread devastation. Before it strikes, an atmospheric light known as the Shimmer typically appears, serving as an early warning.

A warm, humid underground haven deep beneath the Roya Frostlands. Following an ancient polar shift that made Lahai-Roi Solaris's new pole, the changing climate drove the surface-dwelling Roya to migrate below. Long isolated, it became a refuge for extinct prehistoric life, which has since evolved into a unique and remarkably independent ecosystem.

Officially titled the Spacetrek Collective: Startorch Academy, this borderless academic metropolis trains Synchronists and spearheads research into the giant mech known as the Exostrider. Its name embodies its core ethos: "to carry the flame of inquiry and ignite the torch of civilization." Here, seekers of knowledge from across the world gather, knowledge flows freely, and cultures meet in harmony.

An operation conducted by Septimont's Gladiators to eliminate the Dark Tide and its creations within the Sanguis Plateaus.
The Plateaus' unique terrain allows Remnant Energy to accumulate, sustaining the lingering Blightcloud hanging over the area, a remnant of the first Dark Tide outbreak in Rinascita. Consequently, the region has become a breeding ground for Dark Tide creatures, where the Dark Tide's corruption continues to spread unchecked.
As the confrontation with the Dark Tide stretched on, the Septimontians discovered a strategy to effectively curb the Dark Tide's advance: luring its creations toward the Earthrend Wedge and hunting them near its base. Since then, the "hunt" gradually evolved into an institutionalized tradition deeply woven into Septimont's culture.
A type of Tacet Discord born from the Dark Tide.

A colossal wedge-shaped structure located in the lower levels of the Sanguis Plateaus. It descended from the high heavens alongside Rinascita's Sentinel Imperator, who had full control over it. When the first Dark Tide outbreak struck Rinascita, the Earthrend Wedge was activated. Its energy field effectively suppressed the Blightcloud above the hunting grounds, preventing it from spreading into Septimont's urban areas. Subsequently, the Dark Tide stemming from the clouds has been mostly contained within the lower levels of the Plateaus.
Located on the outskirts of the city of Septimont, it's the "air terminal" where Gladiators cross the canyons and make their trip to and from the Sanguis Plateaus.
The living quarters of Priestesses, where fate is observed and prophecies are documented. Commonly referred to as the "Temple."
The main hunting ground on the mid to upper levels of the Sanguis Plateaus, where generations of Septimontians battled the Dark Tide and its creations.
A Common Echo in the form of a large horn. Hornett's high-pitched and lengthy blare is used to signal the beginning or the conclusion of large-scale hunting operations.
The mainland of Septimont and the Sanguis Plateaus are separated by a narrow and long waterway.

A unique flame produced by igniting specific minerals. Its appearance resembles sunlight more than ordinary fire. The precise types and proportions of minerals used to create this flame are a closely guarded secret, passed down exclusively through generations of Priestesses.
While the Sacred Flame offers no special power, Priestesses channel their Resonance power through it, using its light to glimpse the future and deliver prophecies.
Yet to the Priestesses, the Sacred Flame is more than just a medium for divination. They view it as "celestial light descended to the mortal world," often referring to it as "the flames."

The ruins of a bygone civilization, said to be hidden deep beneath the Sanguis Plateaus. Its entrance is located in the Wastelands. Long ago, it was visited by the three Heroes of Heroes from Septimont.
Legend has it that those who manage to set foot in Manes Deep can hear the whispers of the Heroes of Heroes and thereby gain powers rivaling their own. Some also hold that since the Heroes of Heroes walked this place, the journey to Manes Deep has become an inescapable trial for any who would claim that title.

A medal bestowed by the rulers of Septimont exclusively to Gladiators who demonstrate exceptional performance in the hunt against the Dark Tide. It is regarded as one of the highest honors among Gladiators.

Có nguồn gốc từ vùng Septimont, Griffrexes từng chung sống với tổ tiên của Septimont, những người đã tìm nơi ẩn náu ở Rinascita.
Tuy nhiên, sự bùng nổ của Thủy triều đen tối đầu tiên đã tàn phá Dãy núi Biên giới, môi trường sống của Griffrexes, khiến hầu hết các loài này bị tuyệt chủng. Kể từ đó, Griffrex chủ yếu tồn tại dưới dạng Tiếng vọng chung, được tạo ra ở tần số cố định từ Đèn hiệu cộng hưởng.
Theo thời gian, người Septimonti nhận thức được rằng những tiếng vang Griffrex này vẫn giữ bản năng săn mồi và cảm nhận các tần số bên ngoài. Do đó, chúng được huấn luyện thành Common Echoes cho mục đích săn bắn nhằm theo dõi và tấn công các tạo vật của Dark Tide.

A type of small device manufactured with Tacetite formed around the Earthrend Wedge. It provides energy to Anchor Obelisks, which in turn amplify its frequency to repel the Dark Tide and its creations.
During the hunts, Gladiators of Septimont strategically set up Anchor Obelisks carrying Anchor Stones at critical locations across Maroonwood, the main battlefield. These devices help them drive the Dark Tide and its creations toward the base of the Earthrend Wedge, where they are eliminated. The strategy has proven highly effective in preventing the Dark Tide's spread beyond the Earthrend Wedge's containment.

An installation that can be field-deployed to amplify the frequency produced by Anchor Stones. Once the Anchor Stone is inserted, it can generate an energy field to repel the Dark Tide and its creations.
During the hunts, Gladiators of Septimont strategically set up Anchor Obelisks carrying Anchor Stones at critical locations across Maroonwood, the main battlefield. These devices help them drive the Dark Tide and its creations toward the base of the Earthrend Wedge, where they are eliminated. The strategy has proven highly effective in preventing the Dark Tide's spread beyond the Earthrend Wedge's containment.

A field nestled deep within Maroonwood. At an elevation approaching Earthrend Wedge and situated in the lower middle level of the Sanguis Plateaus, it serves as the primary battleground where Gladiators engage in deadly combat with the Dark Tide and its creatures.
A lost Gladiator town located in the Wastelands at lower levels of the Sanguis Plateaus.
The term referring to the lower levels of the Sanguis Plateaus corrupted by the Dark Tide. This desolate region is marked by hostile conditions and is largely devoid of human activity.

A legendary plant said to grow in Manes Deep. It can survive for years in environments tainted by the Dark Tide, giving it a natural resistance to corruption. When used in medicine, it can slow the Dark Tide's corruption effect on the human body and help restore consciousness.

Victims of Dark Tide corruption who have lost all self-awareness. Their bodies usually resemble stone statues while retaining their original size. Such individuals constantly murmur and recite incomprehensible words and "hymns praising the Dark Tide." The voices from the Hollow Figures have been confirmed to be mentally debilitating, capable of influencing the cognition and mental stability of ordinary people to some extent.

Objects that look like giant stone statues. They are often found near heavily traveled routes or high vantage points, serving as navigational markers for passersby. Some argue that these Waystones are a special type of Echo, formed from the fervent emotional frequencies of Gladiators who traveled through these areas. This theory, however, remains controversial in academic circles.
This type includes Hologram Echo: Chest Mimic, Hologram Echo: Junrock, Hologram Echo: Drake, Hologram Echo: Hoartoise, and Hologram Echo: Puff.
This type includes Tacetite Spikes with Optional Module II, Glacio Beacon, Hologram Echo: Junrock with Optional Module I, Frost Spout, Hologram Echo: Puff, and Freeze Jet
This type includes: Tacetite Barrage with Optional Module I, Hologram Echo: Drake, Hologram Echo: Hoartoise with Optional Module II, Hologram Echo: Chest Mimic, and Burst Launcher
This type includes Repulsor Spout, Vortex Generator, Whirlpool Device.
This type includes Stun Emitter, Tacetite Spikes with Optional Module I, Thunder Lance, and Shock Inductor.

KU-Money's Shop appears after certain waves, where you can consume Sim Credits to purchase Tactics and items.
KU-Money's Shop
A Tactic Set that generates Chain Lightnings bouncing between targets, which is triggered by inflicting Paralysis on the targets.
A Tactic Set that improves resource acquisition efficiency and converts surplus resources into offensive power.
A Tactic Set focused on fire suppression by boosting Attack Speed and Control effects.
The highly recommended core tactics of a Tactic Set.
This type of Tactic increases ATK, Crit. Rate, and DMG of certain Attributes, and reduces Tacet Discords' RES, improving the attack efficiency.
This type of Tactic enhances nearby Combat Machines within a certain range when active.
This type of Tactic enhances debuffs like Paralysis, Slow, Frozen, and Burning.

A planet-wide phenomenon born from an anomalous Lament event. It now blankets Solaris's sky. Research suggests it is composed of extremely high-density Remnant Energy. Since its appearance, all of Solaris's space exploration has been brought to a complete standstill.

The entry point formed when the Exostrider and the Threnodian Aleph-1 entered Solaris. Researchers in Lahai-Roi widely believe it leads to outer space. The overlying Soliskin root network holds Aleph-1's power at bay, the "sealed doors" of the Stridergate.

A phenomenon unique to the surface of the Roya Frostlands. Scholars theorize that this anomaly emerged when the Threnodian's power there attempted to devour the Exostrider, triggering abnormal Voidmatter transformations. Affected objects enter a state of unstable "existence," becoming impossible to observe directly.

A specialized device developed by the Spacetrek Collective for research operations in the Roya Frostlands. It forces entities with fluctuating Voidmatter levels back into the observable state for practical use. In areas with stable signal coverage, the device can be deployed directly to the user's location.

A Court of Savantae space station launched into near-Solaris orbit before the Etheric Sea fully enveloped the planet. Its primary mission was the study of Etheric Sea Droplets, research intended to pave the way for further space exploration.

A high-dimensional domain embedded deep within high-density Voidmatter, existing "inside" Aleph-1. The fundamental laws of time and space descend into total chaos here. Any living entity entering this domain suffers a rapid loss of frequency, eventually leading to the total dissolution of their existence.

A species of seal native to the Roya Frostlands, named for its snowball-like, round, white body. Docile in nature, Snowfluff Seals show little reaction to people or their surroundings, spending most of their time either eating or lying still. Only when facing extreme danger will they rear up and bare their fangs as a deterrent. If intimidation fails, they will promptly retreat to a safer area.

A special pharmaceutical substance developed for extremely rare diseases. However, its severe side effects make it intolerable for most, keeping it under ongoing research and validation. In its natural form, Ichor is a volatile golden liquid that radiates intense heat at room temperature. In rare cases, it can be controlled and stabilized into a solid form.
A pharmaceutical corporation based in the New Federation. Its core technology originates from the development of Ichor, a groundbreaking medical advancement shadowed by perpetual controversy.

Once a reputable poets society in Ragunna, consisting of three members: Faroll, Selena, and Rimbaud. They composed numerous anthems and poems glorifying the Sentinel and the Order, but were later accused of blasphemy by the Order and sent on a Pilgrim's Sail. They vanished thereafter without a trace, and mentioning of their names is now forbidden in Ragunna.

A large cake dedicated to the 1st anniversary of the launch of the Second Coming of Solaris Beta, as well as the control hub for its simulator. When asked about the hub's cake-shaped design, lead designer Encore replied, "What's a birthday without cake! Happy Anniversary!"
A virtual simulation game developed by the Pioneer Association. Despite many setbacks during development, thanks to Rover's trust and support, the game is steadily evolving towards its ideal form.

Officially known as "Remnant Cubes," these advanced artificial intelligences were created for the Second Coming of Solaris using Encore's abilities and Tethys's microprocessing support. Please note: Remnant Cubes are experimental simulations, automatically generated by the system. Their personalities and actions in the game do not reflect those of real individuals.

The Order's executive arm. Unlike Order Penitentiary, which trials the heretics and maintains faith, the Chamber of Discipline deals with secular cases, and enforces law and order, while also overseeing Ragunna's defenses against Tacet Discords. Its enforcers are often referred to as "Inquisitors."

Sonoro Sphere is a space of dense Remnant Energy capable of preserving transdimensional information. In Huanglong culture, such ethereal realms—neither tangible nor illusory—are often referred to as "mirages."
A signal transmission pathway. During its simulation, the Second Coming of Solaris briefly linked with the Tethys System, creating a temporary channel between them.
A mercenary group in the New Federation led by Calcharo.
An ancient epic poem of Rinascita. It pioneered blending various regional folkfore with the tales of the Sentinel, including the first accounts of the Carnevale's origins.
A shore where Rinascitan poets and musicians bury their retired instruments.

The autumn night's brightest constellation, shrouded in legends. A poet of Golden Anthem once wrote, "I am a night hawk of wings aflame, soaring towards the Celestial Steed, whose praises I sing and whose true form I behold." Such imagery always evokes Rinascita's Sentinel. But why soar towards it and behold its true form? Maybe the poem was intended to convey some message.

Music is composed of frequency, as is everything. Thus, everything hums its own melody. Ciaccona's Forte allows her to perceive these melodies; by retuning them, she crafts a Sonoro Sphere in her hands where stories and memories carried in music replay themselves. The deeper her understanding of the melodies, the richer the stories she can summon.

Weapons that can summon Echo projections, such as Feilian Shock and Sanguine Wheel.

Some weapons can be absorbed to evolve another weapon into its Ultimate Form. The evolution requirements differ depending on the Weapon. The evolved Weapons inherit all buff effects of the absorbed weapon.

The Exostrider poured forth light and heat from its Reactor Drive, sheltering life from the killing frost. Grateful for this gift, the Roya revered the Reactor Drive as their sun. They took it upon themselves to gather the Exostrider's "cells," making this quiet labor the duty of their tribe.
Now, their ancient vow is complete. As the new sun rises, they hold the New Solar Celebration, both to mark the renewal and to remind their kin of the purpose that set them on this path.
A Sonoro born of nature. Now a shadowy reflection of the Academy, shifting with the collective psyche of its students and teachers.
Academy's Dark Side
Shadows of students' emotions in the Dark Side, which mirror the hidden feelings within the students' hearts.

Each year, a treasure hunt organized by a mysterious host takes place at Startorch Academy. Participants take home a wide range of rewards, and a single wish is granted for the biggest winner. Though those wishes are always granted in delightfully peculiar ways, this eccentricity only fuels the students' rivalry as they strive to outwit their invisible mastermind.
Minerva's Treasure
If the Dark Side is a vortex of anxiety and sorrow. At the heart of the raging storm is the force that sets it all in motion—the vortex's eye.
Vortex's Eye

Developed by Dr. Scott Rabelle, this method was originally designed to examine Resonators. It is also known as "Rabelle's Test."
Known for its safety, reliability, and ease of use, the test has since been adopted across multiple regions.
Rabelle's Curve
A Resonator born with innate Forte.
A Resonator who awakened their Forte through a life-changing event.
A Resonator who naturally awakened their Forte during their growth.
A Resonator whose latent Forte was prematurely awakened via controlled artificial stimulation.

A mark found either on a Resonator's skin or the ground of a Tacet Field.
For Resonators, these marks serve as conduits for their Forte, a sign of their rebirth after awakening.
In Tacet Fields, the mark becomes the focal point where chaotic energy coalesces, forming the white Resonance Cord that births endless Tacet Discords into this world.

Overuse of power or obsession can overload a Resonator's mind and Forte, leading to Overclocking.
While Overclocking can be controlled, there is currently no known permanent cure.

Threnodians are formidable creatures born from the Laments, with the power to destroy human spirit and feed off of their collapsed will. If civilizations represent mankind's collective will, the Threnodians embody our fears and struggles. They manifest as destructive Tacet Discord disasters spreading across the planet.

The term "Lament" refers to the ongoing catastrophic events on Solaris-3. Since the onset of the first Lament, the cycle of destruction has persisted relentlessly. The tide of devastation remains ceaseless, with no signs of stopping.
A form of pure energy with complete frequencies. The information it carries transcends time and space, enduring in a stable, unchanging state.
Transdimensional spaces where Remnant Energy is abundant are known as the Sonoro Spheres.

The "Tacet Fields" are thought to be where all Tacet Discords originate. These locations feature a sky of inverted seas and a deep cross-shaped Tacet Mark on the ground. Reverberations fill the air, linking our world to an unknown space through a white Resonance Cord. These areas attract gatherings of Tacet Discords.

SOL-3, the third planet from the sun. A world of chaos and change, where old conventions are discarded and disasters run rampant. Human civilization struggles to survive in this new era of destruction and rebirth, facing uncharted challenges with unwavering determination.

The Lament's power causes destructive waves across the land of Solaris. Manifestations like the "Tacet Fields," "Tacet Discord Outbreaks," and the enigmatic "Tacetite" are part of what is collectively known as the "Waveworn Phenomena."

Tacet Discords, beings created by the Waveworn Phenomena bearing "Tacet Cores", are dangerous entities with ever-changing, amorphous forms, which feed on other frequencies to maintain stability and evolution. These creatures mimic their prey's abilities, shapes, and behaviors, influenced by the types of frequency they consume.

A type of special frequency that can be captured by the Terminal to reproduce Tacet Discords' abilities.
There's a chance for Tacet Discords to leave behind "Reverberations" when they are eliminated, which can then be transformed into "Echoes" through the Terminal's Data Bank, providing a useful advantage in battle.

Wherever there is civilization and history, there will be Sentinels. They serve as mankind's guardians and conductors. Their immortal existence has helped humanity through countless troubles, sharing wisdom and prophecies. As humanity embarks on a new journey after enduring the Lament, the Sentinels remain as the record keeper and beacon in times of disaster.
The Magistrate is a governing official who oversees one of the major regions within Huanglong.

The Ministry of Development serves as the engineering and construction arm of the Central Office of State Affairs.
It is comprised of three key divisions: the Ordnance and Defense Divisions, which handle all military applications. And the Infrastructure Division, tasked with public works and construction projects.

The Midnight Rangers are a military force under the Jinzhou Ministry of War, commanded by General Jiyan. They consist of three divisions: Outriders (reconnaissance), Vanguard (offensive operations), and Rearguard (defensive operations).
Public Security Bureau staff who are responsible for the security issues of their jurisdictions.
The local law enforcement arm of the Justice Commission. Operating through Patrol Stations, it maintains civil order and handles public security matters. Its officers are known as "Patrollers."
The local enforcement unit of the Public Security Bureau that handles routine security operations and maintains public order.

Lollo Logistics is a trusted logistics company that delivers not only the tangible, but also the intangible.
Whether it's sending sweet words to a loved one or retrieving lost memories, if it's ordered and can be delivered, Lollo Logistics will handle them with care.

Jinzhou, a fortified city on the frontier, stands guard against the looming Tacet Discord crisis. As one of Huanglong's six major regions, it bears the weight of this responsibility as the youngest provincial capital. The Midnight Rangers defend its northern border without hesitation.
The state-run research institute of Huanglong, with branch organizations established in each city.
Located at the edge of the continent, this country borders the sea to the east. It boasts a vast territory with one capital and six major cities.

The most enduring and enigmatic family in Ragunna, the Fisalias are renowned for their expertise in medicine and poison crafting. Their unwavering devotion to the Sentinel is well-known among the citizens.

Nestled on the edge of a cliff in Thessalleo Fells, Porto Veno Castle is a mysterious and magnificent residence of the Fisalias.
Among all the Fisalia family properties across Rinacista, this imposing cliffside castle stands out as the most special. It is the home of the current head of the Fisalia family.

A nation of independent city-states scattered across a vast archipelago, with no central administrative center. It is also known as the "Land of Echoes," which boasts unique natural and cultural landscapes.
Legends speak of how Rinascita's founders fled their homelands and sailed to these islands to escape the Lament.

One of the city-states in Rinascita, Ragunna is a thriving port city on the edge of the sea, its districts linked by winding waterways.
The Ragunnesi are devout followers of the Sentinel, who believe Common Echoes to be gifts from the Sentinel that carry Their divine will.
A two-tiered holy edifice in Ragunna City, devoted to the worship of the Sentinel's statue.

The de facto ruling authority of Ragunna that manages all city matters, from municipal policies and currency to civil disputes.
The head of the Order, known as the Primus, is currently Fenrico, who claims to be the Enlightened One—the Resonator of Rinascita's Sentinel Imperator.
According to city tradition, the Order's clergy serve as the Sentinel's earthly emissaries, guiding the people with Their divine word.
Religious people devoted themselves to the Order of the Deep.

One of the most powerful families in Ragunna, renowned for their pioneering spirit.
The Montelli family played an instrumental role in charting trade routes that not only connect Ragunna, but also greater Rinascita to the wider world. As the city opened its doors, the Montellis rose to prominence, amassing great wealth and unmatched influence.

The Carnevale is the grandest celebration of Ragunna, a time with never-ending masquerades, wine flowing like rivers, and music pulsing through the night.
During this time, people cast aside the weight of the world and surrender to the wild, unrestrained joy of the festival.

At the peak of the Carnevale, the Sentinel is said to manifest and crown the finest performer with the "Laurel."
This honor grants the bearer the privilege to commune with the Sentinel and hear Their wisdom.

The universal currency issued by Huanglong, officially recognized across many regions.
In the ancient past, the ancestors of Huanglong utilized seashells as currency. Though the manufacturing techniques have evolved over time, the shell-like appearance of this currency has endured.
The Sentinel of Rinascita. Though worshipped as the Divinity by the Order of the Deep, Imperator rarely reveals Their presence to the public.
A colossal, whale-like Tacet Discord. Depite its gentle nature, its gargantuan size can inadvertently cause significant destruction.
A Montelli bank situated at the heart of the Ragunna City.

A troupe formed by exiles drifted to the Penitent's End on the Pilgrim's Sails for their supposed "transgressions."
To reveal the truth hidden by the Order, they wrote numerous plays and "danced in chains," performing tirelessly across the archipelago.

Solaris' foremost authority on observing the Lament cycle.
Through constant observation and analysis of Lament's shifting patterns, this organization predicts and warns of impending manifestations before they occur.

Also known as the Civilization Simulation Sand Table, the Tethys System is a supercomputer unique to the Black Shores. By inputting Lament frequency data—collected both manually and via beacon access—into the system, the Black Shores can issue Lament warnings for locations worldwide within a 24 to 48-hour time range. This capability is the cornerstone of the Black Shores' extensive collaborations with countries across the globe.

Modulation is the process of adjusting frequencies. In Solaris-3, frequencies serve as a crucial tool for uncovering the truth about reality. By altering these frequencies, one can delve into the very core of existence.
At the Black Shores, modulating Stellar Matrices is crucial for tracing and analyzing the Lament. Over the course of the Black Shores' history, only one individual has ever been honored with the title of "The Modulator"—Rover.
Patrollers in Jinzhou.
A globally popular competitive sport that puts both the strength and endurance of its participants to the test.
A unique martial art practiced by Yuanwu, known for its heavy and fierce strikes. However, only those who temper their strength with precise control can wield it without breaking themselves.
Danjin's favorite dessert. It is considered a symbol of good luck and blessings because of its association with loong.

One of the Sentinels of Huanglong, taking the shape of a Loong. The guiding force behind Jinzhou's civilization.
A majestic "deity" with unquestionable power, omniscient of Jinzhou's past, present, and future. Jué, the wielder of time's flow, sees eons as mere moments. In an instant, Jué can change the universe forever.
"Seasons shift by decree, and all beings abide by their laws. Such is the nature of the universe."

A grand construction located in the central axis of Jinzhou. Not only it reserves the functions of important reception and discussion of major issues, but also sets itself as the symbol of hope for the people of Huanglong.

The head governor of Jinzhou.
In Huanglong, when a Magistrate takes office, they adopt the region's name as their own. For example, Jinhsi was originally named Hsi but changed her name to Jinhsi after becoming the Magistrate of Jinzhou.

Cantarella's Resonance ability of poison manipulation. It induces vivid hallucinations in its targets, whether manifestations of their deepest desires or carefully crafted illusions.
Like all Fisalia family's abilities, it comes at a price. Prolonged use risks trapping the wielder in their own dreams, blurring the line between reality and fantasy permanently.

A potion Cantarella developed in her girlhood through relentless experimentation.
While mildly toxic itself, the brew counteracts most poison reactions and induces deep relaxation. It even offers partial protection against Threnodian whispers.
However, those untrained in toxin tolerance may experience hallucinations.
The reality, as opposed to "this side of the dream."
The Other Side of the Dream
A strange being that resides within the Magic Box carried by Roccia. It appears to be born from the inspirations imbued in the collected objects inside the box.
A massive suitcase that never leaves Roccia's side, housing various stage props, play scripts, and Pero.
A dedicated protector of the Magistrate, also serving as their personal secretary.
Magistrate's Bodyguard

Once a renowned Poets Society of Ragunna, its three members—Faroll, Selena, and Rimbaud—wrote many poems praising the Sentinel and the Order.
However, they were banished by the Order for blaspheme against the Divinity. Sent aboard a Pilgrim's Sail, they vanished without a trace, and their names were forbidden in Ragunna.

Rebuilt by Changli during her time serving in Huanglong's capital, this charity organization is directly managed by the Central Court. It provides shelter to refugees and orphans displaced by plagues, famines, and TD Outbreaks.
Changli's mentor, a revered hermit in Huanglong known for his knowledge of statecraft and diplomacy. He traveled widely to share his wisdom and knowledge.
The advisor of Jinzhou's Magistrate. The current Counselor taught Jinhsi the way of governing before she became the Magistrate.

The origin of the games stems from the unwavering faith and determination of the people of Jinzhou to overcome the Lament. What started as a small-scale event to celebrate the victory against the Tacet Discords has now evolved into a military-civilian athletic gathering, aimed at promoting physical fitness and fostering camaraderie between soldiers and citizens to overcome any future challenges together.
A traveling performance group specializing in the traditional Liondance. They take commissions from both the Jinzhou Theater and private clients to support themselves and cover their travel expenses.

Liondance is combination of martial arts and choreography that has now become a signature folk art in Jinzhou. It originated from traditional boxing and martial arts in Huanglong, emphasizing swift footwork and powerful postures.

This traditional performance takes many forms, from solo shows featuring only the Agile Head to a duo combining both the Agile Head and the Steady Tail.
Agile Head is a jargon for Lion Head.
This star-like flower represents love and courage. One day, these earthly stars will blanket every field.
A martial art embodying Taoist wisdom, where practitioners harmonize with nature's rhythms to develop balanced strength of body and mind.
The Averardo Bank run by the Montellis in the Ragunna City.

A popular name referring both to the abandoned underground waterway in Ragunna and the street gang that once operated there. Though the criminal organization was crushed by a mysterious vigilante years ago, rumors suggest they are creeping back from oblivion.

A catastrophe happened twenty years ago that not only destroyed the Avinoleum Theological Seminary but also wreaked havoc across Ragunna.
For the people of Ragunna, it was the sacrifice of Fleurdelys, the Blessed Maiden, who single-handedly halted the Second Dark Tide.

A decade ago, the Carnevale was attacked by a giant sea creature and plagued by TD outbreaks. Primus Fenrico intervened to end the chaos, but the event left new wounds for Ragunna City, which was still recovering from the Second Dark Tide.
Carnevale Event A Decade Ago
The Midnight Rangers have three divisions: Outriders (reconnaissance), Vanguard (offensive operations), and Rearguard (defensive operations), all under the command of General Jiyan.
A Remnant Creature reminiscent of a white udumbara. It can communicate with Baizhi through telepathy.
You'tan
A type of special Stellar Matrix used to contain the errors and discarded data of Tethys System.
A special expanse that collects all the dreams in Solaris since it came into being. It is managed by two Gatekeepers.
A special dimension dedicated to the mysterious film festival in the depths of Somnoire. Though isolated from the rest of Somnoire, it boasts the best equipment and environment for movie screenings.
An activity held in the depths of Somnoire. You've been invited to be a judge, but the identity of the host remains a complete mystery.
The Tacet Discords emerge from the frequencies of nightmares and negative emotions. They can often be found in Somnoire.
One of the administrators of Somnoire, tasked with deleting "useless data" within the realm, or so he says. However, he has his own opinions on what qualifies as "useless."
One of the administrators of Somnoire, tasked with keeping the realm running smoothly, or so he says.
A hidden, inaccessible space deep within Somnoire, where countless collected dreams lie buried.
The largest and most influential Gladiator event in Septimont, as well as a key economic pillar of the city.
A majestic name for the city of Septimont, perched atop Capitoline Hill. Its people are renowned as master sculptors, skilled hunters, and awe-inspiring gladiators who celebrate heroism.
Gryphon's Fortress
An energy drink endorsed by Lupa.
Leaders of Septimont's temple who can foretell fate. They listen to the strings of destiny at a personal cost and offer guidance to those who seek answers.
A play script given by Phrolova. Every actor has their assigned role, and all stories unfold exactly as written, unless...

One of the six major cities in Huanglong, renowned for its abundant waterways, thriving greenery, and enchanting landscapes. Under the guidance of the local Sentinel, the Mengzhou people have developed unique Automata Mechanics.
The current Ephor reformed the Great Agon into a two-on-two competition. Now, gladiators must find a trusted partner to win the championship together.
A popular tavern situated in the commoner neighborhood, famous for its signature drink "Solis." Gladiators often spar there, with the loser footing the bill.
The ruler of Septimont. Ephors wield absolute power, as only the strong are deemed worthy to lead.
In the tales of Huanglong, mirrors are said to reveal hidden truths. And this one appears to show things unseen...
One of the signs that heralds the coming of a Dark Tide. It's when countless Tacet Discords swarm beneath the Blightcloud, descending upon Septimont in waves of destruction.

The final resting place of Septimont's heroes and legendary gladiators. Stone monuments, shaped after each fallen hero's signature weapon, stand tall in tribute to ensure their names and deeds endure through the ages.
Scars of the Dark Tide's touch. It may appear as discoloration, calcification, or even coral-like growths, depending on what has been corrupted.

A premier forge of high-end weaponry and gear, partnered with numerous noble houses. Its premium pricing, bespoke designs, and elite craftsmanship make it the top choice for aristocrats outfitting their champions.
A chain of mountains marking Septimont's edge, severely corrupted by the Dark Tide. Only the most daring Gladiators venture here seeking to train in its harsh conditions.
Participants in Gladiator matches. They are renowned for their strength and battle prowess and driven by an unyielding thirst for victory and glory.
Septimont's signature sport, where Echoes battle beside Gladiators. Victory in the arena hinges on their cooperation.
An Echo formed from the Reverberation of a fallen hero, fused into his armor. It longs to relive the thrill of glorious battle.
Hero's Legacy Armor
Septimont's central city—home to Gryphon's Fortress and the stage of the Great Agon.
The Lioness of Glory, Arsinosa. Born of battle cries and laughter, fused into the stone form of a mighty half-human, half-lion Echo. Since her genesis, she has stood watch over the City of Septimont.

The House Lupa fights for. One of Septimont's founding bloodlines, House Silva's roots once ran deep in the city's spire of influence. But with the rise of the new Ephor, such past glories have begun to wane.
The governing body of Septimont, tasked with advising the Ephor and wielding authority in key administrative matters. It also exercises power over the appointment and dismissal of public officials.
An omen of the coming Dark Tide, one that has lingered over Septimont for years. The region it shrouds is known to Septimontians as the "hunting grounds."
The port that connects Septimont to the outside world. Vessels laden with goods and fresh catch arrive by the hour, while visiting Gladiators and travelers make landfall here upon reaching Septimont.

Date: [--02]
The <ano=CSC>Court of Savantae</ano> Laboratory is an abandoned site in the Whining Aix's Mire. Due to the use of specialized materials developed by the CSC in the main structure, the building is well-preserved and undergoes minimal weathering and corrosion. After a risk assessment, the research committee decided to use the lower levels of the site to create an artificial Tacet Field for experimental purposes.
There are a few abandoned devices left in the experimental area. Low-frequency lighting systems are positioned at specified distances and angles, ensuring consistent illumination in the experimental area.
At the center of the experimental area, multiple bundled cables secure a spherical metal device. These cables also transmit input and output data from the spherical metal device, and identical frequency detection devices are arranged around the spherical metal device. 

These devices are typically operated with dial plates. Clockwise rotation increases electric energy, causing a metal frame to rapidly rotate around the central device for frequency detection.

Date: [--16]
Assembling machinery in a modular way... this "Automata Mechanics" is quite something. Thanks to it, we easily built our new lab. Of course, we couldn't do it without the financial support of that Fractsidus Overseer. Annoying to have someone meddling in our research, given his generous contributions, it's all tolerable.
After all, no choice left. Got expelled from headquarters, so the only way was to move to the Whining Aix's Mire. Sure, the workload increased, but there's an advantage. No one's gonna bother coming to this remote place.
I still remember the moment Professor Heisen announced the trial's success at the meeting. He told us, "I'm getting old, but there's still plenty I can do. And you, you're still young with endless possibilities. I believe each one of you, genius or not, would rather leave your mark in history than end up living an uneventful life in a place like this."
If successful, our names could be immortalized with Professor Heisen's in history, known for generations to come even as ordinary people.
We were once prohibited from research due to the so-called "dangerous activities", expelled from headquarters. We were resentful and frustrated. But now, we've let go of those pointless emotions, focusing solely on paving the way to the future.
Setting aside personal stories, I think, it's more because we've all witnessed "miracles".

NO. SY-A038
Date: [---]

Subject A038 has been assigned to a 6m x 6m x 6m artificial controllable Tacet Field. Regular environmental checks must be conducted every 6 hours for the artificial Tacet Field.
Entry into the designated area is strictly limited to experiment personnel and any devices or tools that do not meet standard specifications are forbidden to prevent interference with the subject.

Preliminary observations indicate that Subject A038, who was born in the artificial Tacet Field, is able to survive stably.
However, it is worth noting that the subject has yet to exhibit any specific physical features or vocal behaviors. It appears to lack a physical form and can only be observed through specialized means.
At present, A038 shows no discernible behavioral objectives and remains mostly stationary with low levels of aggression and activity.
Due to significant deviations from our initial expectations, further research is required to gain a deeper understanding of the subject.
Note: High sensitivity to frequency has been observed. Strict control of standard frequency specifications within the experimental area is imperative.
Given the unique nature of A038, additional time is necessary to establish appropriate parameters and data language in order to gain valuable insights into its information. This process will require a considerable amount of time given our current technology and available data.

WARNING: Any leakage of experimental information through any means is strictly prohibited. Taking photos or recordings of the subject without express permission from Professor Heisen is strictly forbidden.
This concludes the initial observations recorded for Subject A038. To obtain more comprehensive information on the subject, future experiments and analyses are crucial.

Date: [--08]
We've reached the final stage of our research, but it seems we've slowed down our progress. Colleagues are leaving one after another. Even Professor Heisen said he's going back to be with his family... He did say that, right? 
Somehow, I'm not so sure about this. I just vaguely remember he mentioned something like this at some point, but did he actually tell us that? Or did he whisper it in my ears?

During long, boring nights like this one, this little thing is my only companion. It's hard to believe how much it has grown and changed. Metal parts now adorn its once simple form: steel plates, cogs, clocks, detection devices, blue liquids, white lab coats... and… Is that a diesel generator? Anyway, I can finally see it with my own eyes, without the aid of observation devices.

Hello? How are you feeling today? You seem surprisingly energetic. But it's no wonder, being trapped your entire life. Longing for freedom, I imagine. 
Our lab is rarely this quiet. I think no one would notice if I broke the rules a little bit. 
Ah... I see. So this is how your body feels to the touch. 
Is that how you laugh? This is the first time I've heard your voice... It sounds familiar, like my colleagues.
I can see it... It’s the Gate we've been searching for. 
Why am I feeling dizzy? My body, it’s so soft now… like water... not my own.
My consciousness, floating in the air...
Hello everyone… So you've all entered the Gate already…
"Don't cross over," you say… What do you mean?
No, something's not right... 
The Miracle we witnessed... This shouldn't be happening...

Today, Master Dollmaker told me stories about Mommy and Daddy again. He said they were brave Patrollers who were betrayed by some really bad people. 

Master Dollmaker only seems to get happy when he talks about this. He promised me that he'd bring them back to me, and when that happens, they'll get their revenge. 

I do miss Mommy and Daddy, but I don't remember much about them. Do they want to become puppets? And get revenge? I don’t know. But if they came back, we'd be happy every day. Right?

Sparrow here. Day 14 of our undercover investigation. Canary and I managed to get hold of the date and location of the transaction, but we've yet to find any key evidence.
Based on various intel, we suspect that Cuckoo has already planted a mole inside the nest. Meaning our cover could be blown at any given time.
With our hatchling barely out of its shell, I had instructed Canary to abort the mission and return to the nest for the sake of safety, to which she refused... She suggests that nowhere is safe if the mole has already planted a target on our backs, rather our optimal plan of action is to stick together and seek out the evidence and the mole as quickly as possible.
We have already entrusted the hatchling to the care of a junior with whom we place our complete trust. We now have no worries. We can and must bring evil to justice.
Memo Covered in Blood Stains

Close... So close... 
Almost there. Almost.
My own memories failed me, and Yinlin is no longer an option. 
I've spent over a decade on these two puppets. I live for finishing this project.
I'll do whatever it takes, even teaming up with those I once despised. 
Sacrifices will be made. I will see it through, no matter what.

Master Dollmaker,

Do you remember this notebook? You said it was a gift from my parents when you became a Patroller. It contained their wisdom and advice, and it was your most treasured possession. It was my greatest inspiration, too.

I've completed my training today. I am now a qualified Patroller. I've decided to become an undercover agent, following in my parents' footsteps. While this may deviate from your expectations of me advancing in the Public Security Bureau, I feel drawn to this path. I may not come back here very often from now on. 

Lately, I've been hearing worrying rumors from the Séance Society. I understand you're facing challenges in your research, but if you've resorted to working with criminals, then you'll be no better than them.

If you stumble upon this message in our camp, please destroy it after reading. I don't know if you'll ever find it, but I hope you do.

I miss our talks, Master Dollmaker. I've been thinking about my parents, and there is something I have to tell you. Please, let's talk again.
Same as last time, Rover. You know how to find me.

After my mentor passed away, I have been practicing swordsmanship on this mountain for twenty years. Cold or hot, rain or shine, I have been wielding my blade, hoping to one day reach the ultimate state of swordsmanship. During this time, I have defeated countless enemies with this Sword, including martial artists who held contempt for me like I held to them, and terrifying TDs that arose from nowhere. Every day, I had to endure endless battles and hatred.
I am convinced that this Sword is sharp enough to defeat enemies, but not possible to resolve the confusion in my heart... It seems that I need a new weapon. As for this Sword, I will leave it to someone destined for it.

Twenty years have passed, and I believe I have gained a deeper understanding of swordsmanship. I have abandoned the light, sharp Sword, and opted instead for this heavy Broadblade. It lacks the intensity and agility of Sword and even appears somewhat clumsy. However, these are merely prejudices born from a lack of insights into blades. Actually, the mix of impetus and inertia of Broadblade is like a dance, always catching my foes off guard. The seemingly plain and unadorned moves are, in essence, a product of exquisite control of strength.
However, as I gaze upon the Broadblade in my hand, I am acutely aware that neither it nor I can ever truly reach the pinnacle of perfection, and that I must continue my search... This blade, I shall leave it to someone more suited. 

Over the hasty course of twenty years, I have gradually come to understand the essence of swordsmanship. It is not about being confined to the form of the weapon in my hand, nor about the countless techniques I have spent my life mastering.
As long as there is a blade in my mind, any kind of weapon and technique can achieve the purpose of defeating the enemy.
Take this "blade" as an example. No matter how far the enemies may be, they cannot escape from its sharp edge. Besides, it is swifter than any technique! It can be said to be the epitome of a blade. Unfortunately, I realized this far too late. My aging body can no longer control it for much longer. Thus, I have hidden it somewhere in the depths of Port Town of Guixu. I hope someone flexible enough may find it.
As for myself, perhaps in the final stages of my life, I will take on a student and impart to him my lifelong understanding of the art of swordplay.

To remember where I buried them, <color=Highlight>I took three photos from this hilltop</color> — if there is truly someone destined, then perhaps they can make use of these photos to find these three knives that recorded my life.
Unknown Master's Journal

A small military transport aircraft crashed during a cruise towards ■■■. The cause of the crash was under investigation. At approximately 8,000 feet, the Flight made an initiation of a descent towards ■■■. The aircraft disintegrated as it crashed to the ground. All crew members were killed in the accident.
Shortly after the departure, the Flight reached 8,400 feet at 13:46. The craft issued a "Deviated from Course" alert at 14:40:25, after which it drove out of cruising altitude. The crew failed to respond to the alert.
Last recorded status: 
Standard pressure altitude: 4,234 meters; Course: 108 degrees. 
No recorded radar signal afterward.
The aircraft is entitled to a valid flight certificate with no necessity for large-scale repair during the last inspection. All crew members possess valid and legal licenses to operate the Flight. Normal safety inspection procedure conducted before boarding.
Along the cruise, all navigation and surveillance facilities functioned normally until 14:41:36 the flight plan was interrupted by temporary haywire indicators. Upon the investigation of the wreckage, the aircraft found no attack trace by EMP. Unable to identify the probable cause of the accident under the Waveworn Phenomenon, the Board demands an urgent change in approaches to investigate this case.
The follow-up investigation is ongoing.
...
30 days after the crash of ■■■ Transport Flight, the black box was retrieved for further investigation on the tapes and recording. It's acknowledged that the crew members had taken safety precautions to record all anomalies.
According to the black box, a glitch appeared on the monitor screen at ■■■. They encountered an upsidedown metropolis in mid-air, while dense fog prevented the aircraft from pressing on. This was reported as a typical phenomenon of the Etheric Sea. The crew made difficult adjustments, to no avail. Out of control, the captain was hit on the head compelled by the abnormal gravity. The co-pilot applied unsuccessful emergency breaks, after which the aircraft went straight to ■■■.
...
To conclude, it's accepted by all that the detrimental effects of the Lament are defying our technology, as no scientific grounds can be used to explain such accidents. In recent reports, the Etheric Sea is spreading with troubling Retroact Rain that affects residents. To survive these disasters, we need to take measures to unravel the underlying truth of our world.

As the Express through the Rain I
The door swings open with a creaking. I turn around, portraying the raindrops with my eyes. Shall they end up in the sea upon the skies? I don't know, nor the destination of this express. Now and then I remember the past, when you and me crouch in one silhouette on those rainy nights. Will we return, back to days of blooming petals and neon lights?

As the Express through the Rain II
I remember, I do. Wet neon, frantic traffic, they all dance like Tetras. We don't care about umbrellas. As we shuffle through shallow depressions on the ground, our swirling skirts willingly embrace the splash. We dance to the tune of rain, dreaming without concerning the days. I wish I could dance with you till we catch the sun; I wish the rain never ends; I wish we never part ways.
That's when we see the flashing light. Bathing in those glowing drops, we chuckle out in the pouring rain. As the car chimes hard, I hear your voice: Can we continue the dance, continue without a finale? I say yes, no finale. We'll stop for no one.
Unsullied by doubt, you nod. In your full skirt, the rain is returning to the skies.
The express, descending from the air, carries you away with strong whistles.
Then, silent neon lights are smashed to the ground and feed me the splashes.
Then, the rain is gently consumed by the flames.
Then, I get swallowed by that rainy night.

As the Express through the Rain III
All our dreams disappear in the heavy rain, as they evaporate in the aching land.
The spreading fire burns every vein and valve, so as the rain drops about to meet the ground.
I see crawling petals come out of the soil, tearing down the foundation with their bodies. I can only escape, stumbling through the night and howling rains as I cling to the past shadow of you.
The scorching land permits the failure of our dreams. I lose you.
But the rain revisits here, along with the same old train.
In playbacks I see the express, welcoming me with open doors. Everything is still the same.
So I take a step forward. The door closes with a simultaneous broadcast. Am I seeing phantoms, mimicry of dizzy passengers in every cabin?
But that doesn't matter. As I find you, I ask you for permission to sit by your side. Same as you inviting me over a never-ending dance.
The answer is yes. Nothing will stop the express, not the rain nor the broken rails, until it greets the next desperate passenger.
As the Express through the Rain

Jinzhou Folklore Journal I
Jinzhou is the newest city of Huanglong. It rests on the frontier where perilous monsters lurk. Devoting all its strength, Jinzhou thrives against continuous threats and moves steadfastly on a buoyant path.
Adjacent to other cities, the Gorges of Spirits marks the throat and the inevitable gate on every route. Through Jinzhou, visitors can find their way to the entire Huanglong. Embracing such geographical pre-eminence, Jinzhou continues to enlighten poets and merchants, bringing forth inspiration and fortune.
The culture and spirit of Jinzhou all included in this book, begins with the battle in the Gorges of Spirits.

Jinzhou Folklore Journal II
In the distant past, Gorges of Spirits was known as the crawling nest of Tacet Discords. In dying will, soldiers of Huanglong safeguarded their homeland against the approaching storm of destruction. Shed blood converged into a solid dome that intercepted their enemies before they cast the final dice.
Suddenly, a long cry came from under the Gorges, shaking the ground with Loong's mighty existence. Cutting a chasm in the sky, this creature set the stage amidst an overwhelming light. As the bell clanged, a fighter with golden eyes descended, piercing a sharp blade through the Crownless. Like blares of horns support arrived from all sides, filling the battlefield with cheers and fighting wills.
After this battle, the Gorges of Spirits was appointed as the defending border, protecting Jinzhou and the people of Huanglong.

Jinzhou Folklore Journal III
The statue of Sentinel is located at the exit of the Gorges, a dominant figure and a permitted talisman standing between all chaos. The Sentinel of Jinzhou "Jué" represents one star of Qingloong, carrying a message to cleanse evil and bathe Jinzhou in its pure blessings.
Whenever a Magistrate is chosen, or every decision is about to be made, Jué will be present as a guiding hand.

Jinzhou Folklore Journal IV
The common rendezvous for the festivities of Jinzhou starts from Knell Square to the Statue of Sentinel. People pray for blessings in front of the silent statue, no matter if it's for yield or peace.
During the Spring Loong Festival, the streets of Jinzhou will be bustling with activity, filled with bouquets and drums of Liondance. Normally, people welcome it with cleaning while merchants release new products to celebrate the arrival of a brand new year.
The Midnight Rangers too follow these etiquettes. As they stand tirelessly to ward off Tacet Discords in those prevailing nights, citizens of Jinzhou could gather in joyous reunion.

"Here comes a beast, akin to a lion. It exudes might and intellect, embraces a human's act..."
Long ago, a recluse beast "Suan'ni" inhabited the distant jungle of Huanglong.
Legend had it these great fighters abhorred evils as deadly foes, endowing humans with generous courage. Its figure frequently led the fight troops, overwhelming enemies with great strength. One against a hundred, it disrupted the offensive Tacet Discords, hence honored as an auspicious beast and a loyal friend by its human companions.
To commemorate such success and pass down its blessings, human created the Liondance that adopted their moves into dancing footwork. To this day, the Liondance still embraces many successors among Huanglong.
This precious friendship lasted for hundreds of years hereafter.
Unfortunately, the Waveworn Phenomenon began to flourish, devouring living beings and the vibrant jungles where the connection between humans and Suan'ni moored.
Later on, rumors ruled upon the civil tongues that Suan'ni had adopted a vicious nature.
It was said that they encroached upon human territories and repelled all living creatures within their reach... And they were the harbinger of Tacet Field.
Some objected, saying Suan'ni was an early warning that protected humans from the approaching Tacet Field danger.
Difficult to tell their nature, people raised a big question mark on the existence of Suan'ni... In mere speculations, I tend to mark those evil ones as a narrow slice of Suan'ni.
As for the reason... perhaps it has possible connections to the loss of territories, struggles of power induced by depleted resources... Or the Waveworn Phenomenon should have contributed largely to their raging mutation.
As researchers achieved further discovery, it's acknowledged by most that Resonance Ability can be an acquired strength that stems exactly from one's heart. Without proper treatment, it begets destruction. In later research, it was confirmed that Suan'ni possesses a special power similar to the Resonance Ability. Even a powerful Suan'ni can "Overclock" like Resonators.
Many scientists believe Suan'ni accepted eventual extinction as they failed in the war against inner brutality.
However, I believe the survivors of Suan'ni will recall the past friendship with the human race.
Out of a natural curiosity toward legends of beasts, I decided to venture into the realm once Suan'ni resided. If anyone finds this interesting through my article, my efforts will not yield fruitless.
Next stop, the Violet Banyan.
Study on Mythical Beasts in Huanglong

Lo, Lo, Lollo Logistics! Part One
Lo, Lo, Lollo Logistics! I want to be a proud courier today!
Being a courier, the most comforting sound is the early whistle of vessels arriving at the port. Every day, Port Gunchao witnesses the busiest waterways in Huanglong, transporting both cargo and stories from afar—I know all of these from Miss Lumi!
According to Miss Lumi, Port Gunchao constitutes the largest freight transportation port in Huanglong! Every cargo to Jinzhou must travel through this port! As ships rest upon the morning bank, a long whistle utters in the air, announcing the arrival of new freight and the start of a busy day.
Couriers like me must fulfill every order without mistakes as they bear anticipation from every inch of SOL3 through mountains and seas. Recently, frequent delivery requests from Tiger's Maw Mine appeared on my list. The thought excites me that I could help to convey these precious vehicles of love and voice to Shuzhou, Shaozhou, and places on the distant corners of Huanglong. 
And senior couriers in my branch told me about a fabled island located in the most faraway place on the planet. Only the brightest ones could access the mystic portal to it! If my mail could finally reach its shores, perhaps I'd earn myself the title of a valuable courier! I'm sure that I'll find the chance! Hehe!
Because our topic here is: Lo, Lo, Lollo Logistics! I want to be a proud courier today! Hmm, I nearly forgot... Address... What's the address for our next order...

Lo, Lo, Lollo Logistics! Part Two
Lo, Lo, Lollo Logistics! I want to be a proud courier today!
Now that I've mentioned sounds, maybe the friction when the breeze gently laps on our uniform deserves to be on the list! I could hear the roaring gales as I ride the express car to deliver my orders. It serves as a reminder during my journey, urging me to hurry my pace with louder chants.
But please note that safety is the first on the road! Because you may bump into dangerous Tacet Discords that look pretty alike to traffic lights. Just follow the rules: red for stop and green for go, keep this in mind every time! Or you'll catch the attention of vicious monsters! No one can predict the situation around the port, since Tacet Discords are haunting us with their looming existence... It even gets worse when we have to commute between here and the obsolete port... 
Oh, that used to be a place of glamour like Port Gunchao, according to Miss Lumi. But the transportation was ruined by the sudden appearance of the fault zone. To make things worse, Tacet Discords started to pop up from nowhere... Later, the port could only bid farewell to its busy days and sink into dust. Such a waste. I think many packages are held up in the port to this day... Well, that's not what you expect of an express. I wonder if these packages could finally meet the right ends...
Maybe our new supply station will do the trick? Okay, my next workplace is settled then! Lo, Lo, Lollo Logistics! I want to be a proud courier today!

Lo, Lo, Lollo Logistics! Part Three
Lo, Lo, Lollo Logistics! I want to be a proud courier today!
Continuing our topic on the sound... I don't think I can skip the strange murmurs from Whining Aix's Mire. No, those are totally INSANE!
Let me explain in detail: I've made a transfer request to the new supply station. But some Exiles lurking in the neighbors just raided our camp and robbed us blind. I can't believe this... I know these aren't just common packages, they're potent representations of feelings. Miss Lumi agrees with me. On our first encounter, I already knew her as an impressive navigator. Though young, she deals with every order with delicacy, and that allows her to locate the fastest route despite all the obstacles and rubble along the way. When she delivers a package, intact as it is, to her customers, she ends her service with a radiant smile. How sweet...
By the way, Exiles are just one subtle part of our difficulties. Take the dense fog in Whining Aix's Mire for example. It usually signifies an accompanying thunderstorm and shrill screams that bring up a ripple of sadness and... a sense of longing. That's where the navigation tends to fail as the fog gradually consumes you.
Devastating events. I can't quite picture myself overwhelmed by such dense fog and Siren sounds... Eek! I can't dwell on this. Time to get back to work and be a proud courier today!
Lo, Lo, Lollo Logistics!
