Untitled Family Letters II
I found this letter after Xiaobao went to bed.
Don't worry... Everything is fine now. Xiaobao helped me a lot. Though strange things happened under the mine, that's no sweat at all to my job. We take care of ourselves, and you should too.
You reminded me of my father, a soldier who seldom came home. I missed him so much and kept asking my mother the same question: When would he come back? But the war was escalating and those Tacet Discords were approaching our doorsteps. I remember a courier delivered a mail on a rainy day. I could tell right away that it was from my father. I came out of my room with a happy smile, when the courier paused for a conversation with my mother. Turning around, she cried over my shoulder, shedding tears upon that letter I dared not to read it myself.
I know they sacrifice a lot to drive those Tacet Discords out of Desorock Highland... and you're now suffering in bitterness at the front line. That gentle knock on the gate still chants a scary echo for me to linger upon the slightest thought that you would die like my father. So I told the couriers to leave those letters on my doorstep.
Enough of the past. Are you doing fine on the front line? Don't worry about us, you just need to do your job. We love you, as always.

Untitled Family Letters III
Worry not, dear. I'm doing fine these days. We managed to defeat a small group of Tacet Discords, while the Ministry of Development is working on some large-scale defense projects. They really know how to use their wit. We will triumph in this battle, believe me. And I miss you too, with all my body and soul.

Untitled Family Letters IV
...I don't know how to start this letter. General Jiyan, I want to say thank you. Thanks to you, his message finally reached us like this.
I recall days with him from time to time. He said someone should be the protector, even if this means sacrifices. In those distant portrayals of the battlefield, you stood unwaveringly against the enemies, supporting him and other soldiers with your might. He said you saved his life countless times. You are his icon, the best soldier who possesses a fighter's heart and a giver's will. He wants to be the same. Although he'd sacrificed his life to cover his teammates, I don't think he'd ever regretted it.
That's what you told me, that he always protects other soldiers even when facing the greatest threats, that he deserves to be a hero.
That night, I met him in a heart-breaking rainy dream that ominously resembled the day when the death of my father arrived. He opened the door, greeting me with his comeback. The early reunion obliged me to ask him: Why did you come back? I thought the war was still raging.
He replied: I just want to check if you're safe. Xiaobao is asleep, right? I'll be leaving now if everything is okay.
And then he added: Everyone on the battlefield just can't mellow out one bit when the war is drawing to an end. They're prepared to go for the killing blow.
I nodded: Just do your job and don't worry about us. Be a fearless fighter and beat those monsters. His steps paused upon a hesitant yes. I urged him to go back, and in anxiety, I met his open arms. He asked me: What if I die in the battle? What about you and Lil. Bao?
Questioned by such a dilemma, I asked in return: Do you ever regret joining the army?
He said no, not if he can protect our homeland.
"So am I." I said.
When I woke from that dream, I was visited by a sudden idea to see the Hero Play with Xiaobao. In the Theater, the heroine in Fiamma wielded a sword bravely against the Fluffernox while the stage bathed in flames. Attacked by the monster, she fell to the ground again and again. As she gathered herself from continued sufferings, tears coursed through my face. I told Lil. Bao that his father is a hero who can rival the Fiamma.
Xiaobao answered this in excitement: I want to be a hero just like him!
I promised to share all these stories with him and all living souls.
General, I would remember this till the end of life, and carve those names upon an eternal stone.

I received a message the other day.
Nothing special, just a message from the train station to the delayed passengers. It reads: "The Future Express apologizes to you with utmost sincerity. We'll keep our service full and complete until you reach the destination." I finished reading and deleted it, thinking "This must be a mistake by the station. I haven't traveled by train for a long time."
But this was just the beginning. I kept receiving strange messages about this Future Express now and then. I transferred them to the spam at first. I live in the moment. Those sorts of long travel and future seem out of my realm. I'm busy running errands around the mine, listening to frequent complaints from those researchers. Even a small miner like me gets a little bit nervous as the year draws to its close.
But these constant messages are killing me. Once I snatched a moment from my job to check them up and one particular piece had captured my attention (probably from a kid): "Daddy. The steward tells me to sit tight because the train is about to leave. We'll be in the future in no time! She would cast a spell that keeps us safe until the train arrives at the future. But I don't know about the future..." These words reminded me of my daughter, the same ever-curiosity when she was young. I haven't seen her in a while, though. I didn't want to disappoint this young sender with all the delay and wait. So I replied: I know the future. Future is where you get to eat Star Flakes and realize all of your dreams.
Several days later, this message thing struck my terminal again with a delay notice: "We're sincerely sorry for the delay. The Future Express will seek for soon departure while ensuring you a safe and happy journey with our best." It even ends with something like "The Future Express will meet you in the future." Another text comes right in: "When do we get to leave? Lil. You keeps asking me about this. I can only respond with empty promises, telling her that 'Soon we will be leaving for the future.' The lobby is full of anxious passengers, each clutching to an urgent desire to leave. And myself included. I received some food from a good Samaritan and that relaxed my nerves a bit. *sigh* When do we get to leave..." This looks like a message for the train station to me but somehow it reached my terminal. Glad that I had a soft time those days. Urged by a passing thought to cheer the sender, I replied: The train will leave soon. Be patient.
It never really cuts off the messages. I still receive them now and then. During a meal with my colleagues, I brought up the topic and all those intricate and haywire messages in my terminal. I sometimes felt compelled to comfort those frustrated passengers.
They said in utter doubt, that there was no such thing as the Future Express.
So I showed those messages to them and met their confused stares. The elder one of my colleagues chimed in, recalling some sort of rail station around the place in the past. It was used as an escape route during a horrible disaster. People named this train "The Future Express", carrying a message that you could ride with it until the bitter end and arrive at the future. Ages had veiled the rest of the story when they only came along the tongues of the past generations. Even he didn't know what happened later. I can't help but think, if the Future Express truly belongs to a forgotten past, then why would I receive these messages...

Dim Forest Survey Team Diary: I
We conducted a comprehensive survey and inspection of the Dim Forest and have come to the decision to revive the old research site of the Forest Nature Reserve. A rearrangement and categorization of the legacy data stored inside was conducted. During this process, we even discovered seeds and specimens of some plant species that have long since been deemed extinct. These precious seeds and specimens can help us gain a better understanding of the ecological changes the Dim Forest has experienced and the impact the Lament has placed on this area. 
Next, we will perform a comprehensive survey of various resources of the Forest, such as soil, water, etc., and focus on studying the local TD population of Hoochiefs. Based on previous reports, there have been several assault cases involving these Hoochiefs. Explorers who have encountered these TDs claimed that they frequently appear in groups. With this information in mind, we require all investigators entering the Dark Forest to travel in teams and take precautionary measures when necessary. 
(Cangmin: This is information regarding the establishment of the Dim Forest’s Department of Ecology. Long after the ending of the Lament, the situation in the Forest gradually stabilized, inviting researchers to conduct studies.)

Dim Forest Survey Team Diary: II
10:00 A.M.
Several Hoochiefs were found near the research institute. Through observation, it was found that these Hoochiefs possess group consciousness to a certain degree and perform physical gestures to communicate with each other. All personnel in the institute have been notified to maintain a safe distance with the Hoochiefs.
1:00 P.M.
Appearance of a second Hoochief.
2:45 P.M.
Appearance of a second Hoochief group. A small-scale conflict occurred between the two groups. One of the groups seemed to be covered in some kind of spores. The Hoochiefs without spores were defeated and fled the scene.
6:00 P.M.
The Hoochiefs attacked the research institute and one was captured. The institute will shelter the Hoochief.
The behavioral characteristics of these Hoochiefs will be recorded and the engineering team are requested to install bionic cameras for our research. In the mean time, the Waveband of the Hoochief will be thoroughly analyzed.
(Cangmin: Study currently at preliminary stage)
(Qiaomu: The spores were later confirmed to be poisonous.)

Dim Forest Survey Team Diary: III
We deployed several bionic cameras to observe the Hoochief groups. The following cameras were deployed. Three in the form of bushes, two in boulders, and one in Hoochief form. The Hoochief camera was able to imitate their movements to a certain extent, but were relatively robotic and failed to perform complex actions. In this round of filming, two bush cameras were destroyed, with the boulder cameras being used by the Hoochiefs as throwing weapons, resulting in critical damage to their lenses.
The Hoochief camera continued to follow the Hoochiefs and filmed their leader. The Hoochiefs did not show any aggression towards it, but the camera was immobilized due to a malfunction in its motion systems. The Hoochiefs later performed a "burial" for it around the banyan tree.
We will sweep the area around the banyan tree and recover the cameras.
(Qiaomu: The bionic cameras really came in clutch. Real MVPs!)

Dim Forest Survey Team Diary: IV
The sheltered Hoochief is covered in spores emitting a red glow. Researchers who came into close contact with the Hoochief for an extended period of time exhibited signs of coughing and difficulty breathing. As a result, researchers have been restricted from making close contact. 
Days later, the Hoochief began to show signs of crazed tendencies. It continues to devastate its surroundings while scratching its own body and coughing constantly. 
Further observation of the Hoochief is required. 
Additionally, we have observed an increase in the appearances of Hoochiefs near the research institute, likely influenced by the sheltered Hoochief's frequency. This requires special attention. 
An investigation into the Hoochief leader is to be carried out as soon as possible.

Dim Forest Survey Team Diary: V
Feilian Beringal, Howler, Overlord Class Tacet Discord. 
Based on our studies, the Feilian Beringal resides around the Giant Banyan and is the leader of the Hoochief group. The creature maintains highly aggressive territorial behavior and will show strong hostility towards intruders. Several of our survey teams received major setbacks during their investigation of the Beringal.
The Feilian Beringal, along with the Hoochiefs under its command, are mimetic creatures capable of imitating the behavior of the apes that once existed in the Dim Forest, bearing a certain level of intelligence. they copy humans to wield simplistic tools and weapons, and will also comfort and protect their companions.
In the meantime, further spread of spore infection was observed. Hoochiefs covered in spores tend to be more aggressive. Caution is advised.
Research studies of this phenomenon are currently underway.

Dim Forest Survey Team Diary: VI
With the assistance of the Midnight Rangers, we carried out a special operation on the Feilian Beringal. Through great efforts, we managed to put a tracking bracelet on the Beringal, which will help us monitor its movements in the forest and avoid any direct confrontations.
During this operation, we discovered that the number of Hoochiefs infected with the spores was much higher than we had initially estimated, and the rate of the spore's spread was faster than the prediction models had shown. The spores can significantly affect the qualities of surrounding soil, water resources, and other environmental substances, and cause near-irreversible damage to the human body. Given that the Hoochiefs are the source of transmission of the spores, their expulsion from the area will be put in place. However, some researchers believe that the Hoochiefs are not the source of the infection itself, and have submitted a secondary proposal to begin research on spore antibodies.
(Senming: My mentor was the one who initiated the antibody research. She placed hopes to resolve the Forest's complications through this way.)

Dim Forest Survey Team Diary: VII
Progress on the research of antibodies has been considerable. We believe a result is soon within reach.
Haste expulsion of the Hoochiefs failed to yield meaningful effects, and in turn, triggered more frequent Hoochief attacks. To minimize and avoid escalation of this situation, we've changed our approach and instead focused on sheltering the apes by helping to remove the spores from their bodies and alleviate their emotions.
We hope that this will help us to better carry out our work.

Dim Forest Survey Team Diary: VIII
A series of complications, in forms such as Hoochief disturbances, led to the loss of the majority of our research data.
However, while scavenging for data, we were still able to witness the valiant efforts made by our predecessors on the Dim Forest.
<ano=Ecoacoustics>Ecological</ano> research is a complicated study. Topics such as finding critical entry points and how to begin our research are all topics we need to be mindful of.
Fortunately, we now have more time to ponder.

I. Objectives
1. Assess the feasibility of spore essence extraction.
2. Investigate the diverse effects of spores at different concentrations.
II. Materials
Hoochiefs, with one uncontaminated and one contaminated specimen per group; 1ml syringe, saline solution.
III. Procedure
1. Group two Hoochiefs with similar body weights, weigh them, and assign unique identifiers.
2. Extract spore essence from contaminated individuals, blend it with saline solution, and establish concentrations of 0.2%, 0.4%, and 0.8%, categorized by groups.
3. Administer various concentrations of the spore extracts to uncontaminated individuals, observe their activity, and record findings.
4. After completing the experiment, conduct statistical analysis on the results and formulate conclusions.
IV. Conclusions
1. The spore essence extraction process results in approximately 58% loss, but extraction remains viable.
2. The 0.4% concentration of the extract exhibits the optimal effect, although outcomes may differ based on subjects and necessitate further validation.

Note: Achieved interim success. Transitioning the experimental subjects to humans is authorized.

Hello to the later of Haymarket, where I was once the city's mayor.
By the time you read this letter, Sea City and I will be about gone. Allow me, in this letter, to tell you of its last glory.
It was a perfect day for stargazing, and on that day we opened the roof of the municipal building especially to view the sea of stars with the citizens of Haiku City who had won the lottery.
Near the appointed time, far more people than expected came up. It wasn't due to stargazing, but because floods and torrential rains had quietly arrived and were attacking Sea City in a big way.
There were strangers who saw each other as enemies, and even former friends and family who had turned against each other in order to grab supplies and to seize the high ground.
I had thought that Sea City was a body of steel, but I didn't realize that she was so fragile in the face of disaster.
So I announced the opening of the passage for all citizens to ascend. Of course, saving everyone is unrealistic. To save one is one, and to last a moment is a moment is the only thought I have left.
This is the municipal building of Haymarket, and in critical moments it should serve the people who co-created it.
Survivors gather here, and what started out as a day of stargazing turns into a day of downright escapism. With dim waves of clouds above our heads and endless floodwaters beneath our feet, we wait for our fate on an isolated island. The sun and moon were gone, and the signal was broken. In the end, I had to make different star maps of the night view of Sea City's neighborhoods and show them to you in a projection.
That was a new promotional video for Hai City just released a while ago, a very beautiful night scene, shot at an altitude of thousands of meters.
In the face of disaster, human beings have lost the right to look up at the stars. But I hope that we can still view our own starry sky and keep that view as a common memory.

The Magistrate's menacing gaze pierced through the trembling woman like a hot knife through butter. "Sign this here contract and you'll belong to me, my dear. "Fine," she choked out, "but I have one condition."

The Magistrate leaned back with a smug smirk on his face. "Go on," he purred.

"That woman? She needs to disappear from this world," the woman demanded, a glint of revenge flashing in her eyes.

The Magistrate's brow furrowed in confusion as he watched her tears. "Sure, " he said quickly, lifting her up with one hand and causing her to stumble into his arms. As she struggled against him, the Magistrate's expression softened and a hint of amusement danced in his eyes.

"Don't touch me!"

"Ha! Don't flatter yourself, sweetie," the Magistrate chuckled. "I wouldn't touch you with a ten-foot pole."

The Dim Forest is unquestionably the most significant treasure trove in the entire Huanglong region, boasting unparalleled species richness in the world.
Upon setting foot at the entrance of this gate, I could distinctly hear the plants whispering and their summons.
It is said that deep within the forest, the former site of the Department of Ecoacoustics holds image records of numerous plants, including a delectable species known as Ivory Banana, originating from the Dim Forest. Ivory Bananas were once a primary food source for Hoochiefs, and, in return, Hoochiefs exploring the forest in search of Ivory Bananas became excellent pollinators.
Since the spread of the toxic spore mist, wild Ivory Bananas have disappeared from the Dim Forest, and information about this species can now only be found in historical records.
The Lament might be an inevitable process of natural selection.
Dim Forest Ecological Survey 1

Guided by the fluorescent plants, I discovered a large purple tree.
Considering its characteristic of resembling an entire forest on its own, I speculated that this tree is likely a sub-species of the Ficus genus. The mysterious purple color on its leaves remains unexplained and requires further research and verification.
Due to the season, I failed to collect samples of the flowers and fruits of this tree, and there were no traces of pollinating insects in the vicinity. Surprisingly, the Violuna Banyan hasn't been contaminated by the toxic spores. Many mysteries still surround it, waiting to be unveiled.
I am certain that this is the first time this tree species has been discovered, and I have temporarily named it the Violuna Banyan.
Dim Forest Ecological Survey 2

After bidding farewell to the Violuna Banyan, I proceeded towards the most important target—the Central Banyan.
It's a tree towering into the sky, with a large spore cloud perched at the top, spreading toxic spores with the wind.
Any creature approaching this tree exhibited obvious anxiety and fear—the white toxic spores floated around the Central Banyan, almost blocking out my sight. I could even hear faint coughing from the forest. I needed to take every step with extreme caution from now on.
The closer I got to the Central Banyan, the more uneasy I felt—there was a heavy snorting coming from its hollow, and the vibrations caused by breathing shook off the spores accumulated on the branches. As more and more spores fell down, I tightened my filter.
These creations of the Waveworn Phenomenon are infiltrating our world, making everything dangerous and unfamiliar.
Dim Forest Ecological Survey 3

It's been a while since I had such an intense workout.

The contaminated Hoochief exhibited an astonishing lack of fatigue in their relentless pursuit of its prey—unfortunately, that prey was me. However, when escaping, I didn't feel panic and my brain started racing. I was well aware that the toxic spores are a direct consequence of the Waveworm Phenomenon. Based on the Ecoacoustics standards, how should we classify those contaminated Hoochiefs? Furthermore, how do those toxic spores contaminate Tacet Discords and is meditation a viable solution for Tacet Discords contamination?

Utilizing the Grapple function, I skillfully swung onto a hidden branch. The contaminated Hoochief lost track of its target and scanned around in confusion. It looked like a lost kid, whimpering and coughing, and it seemed to lose spatial perception. Each intense cough released a burst of toxic spores into the air. The spores, driven by their innate instinct to propagate, further pushed the already weakend body of the Hoochief to its utmost limit.

I started wondering: is it a form of co-evolution, or does it represent a parasitic relationship?
Dim Forest Ecological Survey 4

The social behavior of Hoochiefs is even more astonishing than imagined, establishing them as the dominant species in the Dim Forest.

According to my survey, the toxic spore mist constantly spreads outward from the Central Banyan. To avoid the invasion of those spores, Hoochiefs disperse into different groups, seeking refuge in various safe zones, gradually forming communities characterized by "paternalism". The intelligence displayed by those Hoochiefs seem to be unique among Tacet Discords. Besides, near the Hoochief communities, sightings of activities from other Tacet Discords are notably scarce, which I attribute to a possible manifestation of "territorial consciousness". It was the fifth day into the field and I finally had time to write something down.
I was assigned to be the platoon clerk, a platoon of 30 men. I had to write down what I ate, drank and slept, what I took and what I did. Geiger counters were going off every day, and shells flew by from time to time in the near distance.
I don't know if I was lucky or not, but an enemy bomb hit the bunker I had dug. It burned my Backpack to a pile of ashes. Fortunately, I was passing orders and dodged a bullet. But in the late fall, without a sleeping bag and a change of clothes, and not knowing how to survive the coming winter.
The platoon sergeant in charge of logistics, a warm-hearted man, let me have his brand new sleeping bag and clothes, and went to use the already moldy spares himself. I only took the sleeping bag, promising to return it to him when the rations were issued. He didn't answer or take back his clothes, just smiled and left. The night was too cold and I didn't want to go after him. Might as well wait until tomorrow to give it back to him.

The battle for 91.7 Heights lasted 11 days and nights, and our platoon, including the platoon leader and platoon deputy, lost 16 men, 7 were seriously wounded, and 8 were lightly wounded. The battle was as follows:
In late October, the enemy attacked my 91.7 unnamed heights, after several days and nights of repeated struggle, the enemy has encroached on most of the surface positions. 27 October, my department was ordered to put into battle to support friendly neighboring forces.
Under cover of fire, our unit launched six attacks on the enemy within eight hours, all of which failed to accomplish the task of expelling the enemy from the heights completely.
At dawn on the 28th, the enemy unsuccessfully launched a counter-attack with fire support.
From October 28 to November 6, control of the surface position changed hands several times, and neither side made a breakthrough.
On the night of the 6th, our department was replaced by friendly neighboring forces and withdrawn from the battlefield for repairs due to large losses and more than 70% casualties.
Lesson Learned:
The casualties of our section came mainly from kills by enemy close-range direct fire. This came to prove that the defensive experience promoted in the Army concerning indirect fire was effective; on the other hand, it proved that we were ill-prepared for close-range fighting, a detailed summary of the lessons learned is attached.
Battlefield Record 6010: 91.7 Highland Contest

Today is November 8, and we have been ordered back to the rear to reorganize. The rumbling of artillery at 91.7 is constantly heard, and there is no doubt that height will be the key to the whole battlefield. Whoever mastered it there gained the initiative.
Flesh and blood became the strongest line of defense on that high ground, which was not many square feet, and before which all steel had to bend the knee.
I was glad I didn't borrow the platoon sergeant's new clothes, at least we could bring him home with dignity.
He told me a legend that his grandfather told him. It is said that when a man leaves, in the dead of night his returning spirit will be carried back by the breeze to find his own home. Now that it's late at night, I wonder if everyone has already set off on their way home?

On November 15, we waited to provide support, two recruits in all. Counting the 12 men left over from before, we formed a squad. Since we were still a platoon, I was the acting squad lieutenant, nominally an acting platoon lieutenant.
The battle of 91.7 had depleted the reserves, and it was time for us to return to the battlefield with the remnants of our incomplete formation. Our troops are penetrating to the enemy's rear, just waiting to complete the encirclement so we can completely annihilate the enemy.
The enemy has also realized this and intends to make a desperate attempt to break through our defenses and counter-encircle our two flanks. The fate of this battle will soon be decided.
Battlefield Record 6010: Setting Off Again

That little girl Annalika said that there might be a "Pocket Piano" here, and according to the coordinates she gave, this should be the area.
However, after rummaging around for half a day, I couldn't even see the shadow of the piano, except for some blown-up dolls and toy cars that couldn't run.
This kid can always find something strange and weird from piles of ancient books, but does something like a "pocket piano" really exist?

It's been so humid lately that I'm afraid it's going to be Retroact Rain again, so I found a weapon wreck to get out of the rain.
I came across a pair of siblings who were also stopping here, they were small and a bit wary of strangers, they looked like runaway kids.
I was going to call Mornguard from the camp over there to come over and take the people back, but the two surprised me by pouncing on me and almost bumping into the brim of my hat.
"Uncle, please, don't take us back. My sister and I just want to visit the sea of flowers over there." The larger boy looked at me sincerely, but I was momentarily stumped.
It's just that, who doesn't have a bit of curiosity when they're young. Anyway, I haven't gotten much lately, so why don't I just accompany them to take a look, just as a chance to go to Sea of Flames.

We stopped at the edge of Sea of Flames and the two siblings nodded to each other as if confirming something. Then the boy pulled a small, delicate box out of his Backpack, and after only a moment's hesitation cast its contents into Sea of Flames.
Soon the long utensil melted away in the searing heat, and by the time I turned my head, the two siblings were crying little tears.
I've traveled all over the world and I'm not afraid of anything, but I'm most afraid of little kids crying, so it was good to see that I had put the blown up doll in the treasure chest before, and after I took it out and coaxed it, the little kid stopped crying.
Although this old thing did not get into the tower, it is also considered to make the best use of it, there is a value.

Today was a bittersweet day. I dropped off the kids and received a blurry picture from Annalika, showing a "pocket piano" she found, just like the one I discarded years ago. It turns out that the pocket piano in the Sea of Flames was actually a precious memento of my grandparents' love. They were separated during a battle and made a promise to meet at the sea of flowers, where they would leave the pocket piano as a token of their love. My brother has plans to sell it for SHC, but how can something so priceless be measured in gold? It's moments like these that remind me of how powerful and fleeting life can be. Thank you, two little ones, for showing me the true value of antiques in this modern era.

Annalika called out the waste after looking at my metric record.
Perhaps in her opinion, the only way to realize the true value of ancient objects is to incorporate them into the Condensed Abyss Tower.
If possible, I really hope that this little girl can step out of the Condensed Abyss Tower and experience the real world, and become part of the footnotes of history along with all the metrics.

The closer I got to the Central Banyan, the more uneasy I felt—there was a heavy snorting coming from its hollow, and the vibrations caused by breathing shook off the spores accumulated on the branches. As more and more spores fell down, I tightened my filter.
These creations of the Waveworn Phenomenon are infiltrating our world, making everything dangerous and unfamiliar.

Date: [--02]
The C.V. laboratory is located in an abandoned site within Whining Aix's Mire. The main structure was built using a special material developed by C.V., which prevented severe weathering and corrosion. As a result, the building remained relatively intact. After a risk assessment, the research committee decided to use the base level of the site for an artificial Tacet Field.
A few mechanical instrument abandoned by C.V. are left at the experiment environment. Outside the environment, a low-frequency lighting system was installed at a regulated distance and angle, ensuring permanent illumination of the experiment area.
The experimental environment center is composed of multiple bundled cables that secure a spherical metal device. The cables transmit the input and output data from within the metal device. Surrounding the spherical device are frequency detection instruments of the same specifications. These instruments are typically controlled by dials. When the dial is rotated clockwise, the electrical energy will drive the composite metal frame to rotate in a high angular speed clockwise around the central device for synchronizd frequency detection.

Experimental Environment:
Experiment Number A038 is assigned a 6m x 6m x 6m artificial controllable Tacet Field. Environmental checks for the artificial Tacet Field are required every 6 hours.
To avoid impacting the subject, experiment personnel entering the designated area are prohibited from bringing in devices and tools incompatible with the standard specifications.

Detailed Record:
Initial observations confirm that A038 Tacet Discord, born in the artificial Tacet Field, can survive stably.
Subject has yet to exhibit specific physical features or simulate vocal behaviors. It lacks a physical form and can only be observed through specialized means.
Currently, A038 shows no clear behavioral objectives: mostly in a stationary state with low aggression and activity.
Due to significant deviations from expectations, further research is necessary.
Note: High sensitivity to frequency observed. Strict control of the standard frequency specifications in the experimental area is required.

Due to the unique nature of A038, we need more time to re-establish corresponding parameters and data language to gain deeper insight of its information. Considering our current technology and correlated data, this process will take a considerable amount of time.

Warning: Leakage of experimental information through any means is strictly prohibited.
Taking photos or recordings of subject without Professor Heisen's permission is strictly forbidden.

That concludes the records of initial observations.
To obtain more information on subject, future experiments and analyses are necessary.

Date: [--25]
We have succeeded. The TD numbered A038 has survived the artificial Tacet Field. Though the outcome may be somewhat underwhelming, now is not the time for nitpicking.
The days on duty are so unbearable. I have to stare at this dark mass all night long. It neither moves nor makes a sound, making the nights even more tedious than my stern supervisor. To maintain stability in the Tacet Field, Professor Heisen had removed all the clocks. Sigh, every minute and second feels like eternity. The usually amiable Professor Heisen is unexpectedly strict this time. Since the experiment began, I had hardly seen him smile. By the way, a researcher had accidentally brought a tool with a frequency exceeding the standard into the experiment environment last time, causing a huge commotion. The entire research site sounded the alarm. Fortunately, the Tacet Field and A038 seemed unaffected. However, the size of that mass seemed to have increased slightly. I don't think it made any difference. However, it was the first time I saw Professor Heisen angry.
Alright, I should stop here for today. There are still many issues to resolve. All the parameters and data language established lately have to be typed out manually, and everyone is working around the clock, though none complains. After all, without overwork, where else can we geniuses and maniacs go?

Date: [--08]
The experiment has reached its final stage, but it seems that everyone has become lazy. More and more colleagues suddenly disappear without a trace. Professor Heisen said some of them took leave to spend time with their families, while others decided to take a long vacation before returning. This is completely unlike their usual way. Previously, everyone was so engrossed in the research that they didn't even have time to sleep. Sigh, forget it. It's rare to have such tranquility. In these long nights, only this dark mass accompanies me. I don't know when you grew so big and started moving around. So many mechanical parts and metal chunks have appeared on you. Is that a diesel engine? I feel like I've seen it somewhere before...
Hm? I don’t quite feel like myself today. The body feels so faint it seems a bag of water, not mine.
You seem extraordinarily lively today, don't you? I never expected to see this side of you. It's not something I've seen in our previous encounters. This must be a new discovery. Let me jot it down in my personal memo.
The black spherical object split open, revealing a hidden assortment of items within. Steel plates, gears, clocks, giant drill bits, detectors, spotlights, blue liquid, surgical forceps, thick books, white lab coats, melted candies, adorable cats, electronic displays, and even substances resembling human bodies.
All things from the experiment site. I get it now, that diesel engine is something from the site, too.
Are you giggling? I haven’t heard you making sounds before, but it feels kind of familiar, like one of my colleagues.
My body and my mind feel just...

[Overview] 
Ever since the emergence of the Waveworn Phenomenon, humanity has been fixated on researching the enigma known as the Tacet Discords. 
These entities are seen as sources of destruction and embodiments of chaotic energy. Despite extensive study, our understanding remains incomplete due to a lack of information on their composition. 
As time passes, this gap in knowledge will only widen, resulting in the gradual decay and eventual annihilation of these discords. To sustain itself, the Tacet Discords possess an instinctual drive to consume and merge with other frequencies, in a constant battle to maintain its existence.

[Appendix: Echoes] 
Upon its demise, the frequencies of a Tacet Discord will not immediately vanish. Instead, they will slowly decay over time, allowing for their capture and utilization. 
Once enough frequencies have been stored, they can be harnessed to replicate the abilities of the original Tacet Discord. 
This remaining energy, capable of emulating the defeated entity's power, is known as an Echo — a valuable asset that must be carefully collected and preserved in our laboratory archives.
"Archive: Tacet Discord"

[Introduction]  

Huaxu Academy, a renowned scientific research center in Jinzhou, boasts a rich academic heritage and cutting-edge technology. 
As a branch of Huanglong Huaxu Academy, it has produced numerous groundbreaking research results due to its focus on advancing science and technology in the face of the ongoing war against Tacet Discord. 
The academy maintains a high level of independence in its research pursuits, while also actively engaging in academic exchanges with other institutions within Huanglong and beyond. In fact, it was once a key collaborator of the Court of Savantae. Comprised of four primary departments, each with its own specialized functions, Huaxu Academy conducts parallel and cooperative research initiatives. 
Ad hoc project teams are also formed to tackle major challenges as they arise. While the president oversees administrative affairs, the Principal Investigator serves as the academic leader of the academy.


[Departments]  

Department of Anomaly Studies:  
The Department of Anomaly Studies researches and analyzes abnormal occurrences, constructs theories based on these events, and devises preventative measures. This includes the Resonance Beacon network model and Wutherological Climate studies in Jinzhou.
Main Disciplines: Wutherology, Remnant Ecoacoustics.  

Department of Laboratory Evaluation: 
The Department of Laboratory Evaluation analyzes and simulates anomalies using different theories to find optimal solutions. They also design the internal structure of Resonance Beacon and Terminal for effective use.
Main Disciplines: -

Department of Safety: 
The Department of Safety researches and supports the elimination of Tacet Discord. They design models of the Tacetite Weapon for the Resonator and create countermeasure equipment for civilians.
Main Disciplines: TD Ecoacoustics, Resonology.  

Department of Resources:  
The Department of Resources primarily studies Waveworn substances, processes field materials for research samples, and contributes to the Department of Laboratory Evaluation and Safety.

Ever since the emergence of the Waveworn Phenomenon, humanity has been fixated on researching the enigma known as the Tacet Discords.

July 15
It's been two weeks, and only four of us remain. How did the Tacet Field suddenly appear in this place? I saw scary monsters, countless monsters...
No matter what happens, I will protect Yōu, even if it costs me my life.

Our luck hasn't run out. There's still a small patch of soil suitable for planting. We planted the seeds we risked our lives to collect, and some have sprouted under our care. As long as the plants can grow, there is hope for our survival. I believe someone will come to rescue us. We won't die here. We will be saved.

Dates don't mean anything to me anymore. Only I and a young man survive. Why am I keeping this diary? I don't know. Maybe someone will discover my diary someday? But what good will it do?
The young man mentioned that the rock wall here seems thinner, suggesting that if we tried to dig together, we might find a way out. However, he's currently leaning against the rock wall, his eyes tightly shut, and he hasn't moved for hours.
I lack the courage to check his breathing. I feel terrible. My body is burning up, and my head is aching as if it's about to explode. I keep hearing Yōu's voice. Perhaps she's here to relieve me from all this pain.

Faint glimmers cast their eyes through the crevices, throwing specks of light onto the saddened ground. Placing your hand on the rock wall, you exert a gentle force. With a thunderous roar, the rock wall gives way, releasing a gust of fresh air that rushes in, breathing new life into the train carriage once more.

It's time to feed frequency again? And seriously, I think we've been feeding it too many things. Anyway, it's Professor Heisen's order, so maybe it's best to just follow it...

Title: Spectrum Anomaly Monitoring Report for Subject C-001

Entry: #H-C-6947

Abstract:

The data presented in this report were obtained from spectrum evaluations performed on Subject C-001, also known as "Jué," from June ████ to December ████.

During a preliminary experiment conducted on June 14th, ████ researchers observed a 15-second frequency loss in Subject C-001's spectrum. Five additional tests were later conducted through the following day, and all data obtained reflecting the frequency loss were highly consistent (Margin of error averaged below 0.02).

The recorded data of the Resonance Spectrum on the 3rd, 6th, 11th, 23rd, and 30th of the subsequent month indicated a gradual lengthening of Subject C-001's frequency loss. The data exhibited significant increases with varying patterns. It was postulated that this event occurred due to the presence of Subject C-002, also known as the "Mianloong Chamber." Subsequent thirty-two one-factor experiments confirmed a significant correlation between Subject C-002 and the duration of frequency loss in Subject C-001. Notably, Subject C-002 exhibited an inhibitory effect on the duration growth of Subject C-001.

Based on spectrum monitoring data of Subject C-001 from June ████ to December ████, the following preliminary conclusions can be drawn:

1. Subject C-001 bears defect/malfunction.
2. Subject C-002 can temporarily slow down the escalation of Subject C-001's defect, but cannot make up for Subject C-001's frequency loss.

Appendix-1 (Source: Research Memo #C349)

With the help of the "peculiar visitor", we were given the opportunity to converse with Subject C-001 directly. It was a meaningful and mutual conversation, though we didn't get as much information as I had hoped for.

But at the very least, the conversation proved one point: Our previous research was effective, and there was no defect in C-001. As per C-001's own declaration, "One of the Temporal Programs was lost," and during its prime, C-001 had the capability to manipulate time by decelerating or even halting it, rewinding it, and making corrections as needed. Nonetheless, the current condition of C-001 can be described as one of sickness, with irreversible disruptions to time rendering any attempts at correction or restoration ineffective. Consequently, Mt. Firmament has been transformed into an isolated entity amidst the vast oceans of time, despite the initial purpose being one of redemption.

Appendix-2 (Source: Research Memo #C382)

By running through time flow models, we came up with two hypotheses:

Hypothesis #1: C-001's "defect" is none congenital, and this "defect" may have taken place around the period of C-001's first arrival at Mt. Firmament (it has been confirmed that the "defect" cannot be reversed, see report #H-C-7426).

Hypothesis #2: The discrepancy in temporal progression between the interior and exterior of the "time bubble" has been progressively widening. Based on data comparisons, there exists a correlation between the deceleration rate of time flow in Mt. Firmament and the growth rate of the duration of C-001's frequency loss.

Expanding on the second hypothesis... If C-001 were to eventually cease to exist, the uncontrolled flow of time in Mt. Firmament would likely surpass its limitations and impact a broader range of regions… Such as, the entirety of Jinzhou.

…This might be why that "peculiar visitor" offered to work with us in the first place…

Appendix-3 (Source: Research Memo #C457)

Efforts are being made to advance the development of the artificial Resonance Object. Although we have not yet achieved success, we have decided to name it the "Chronosorter" in honor of our recent progress.

I know we have our "peculiar visitor" to thank for every progress we've made so far. If the "Chronosorter" project is successful, it's a win-win for everyone involved. As I had anticipated, they intend to restore and utilize C-001's complete power in order to rectify the temporal distortion, with the aid of a Resonance Object.

There is still a significant journey ahead of us. This is merely the starting point.

An Adventurer's Diary

April 8
The doctor recommended Fuling receive palliative care at home. Fuling smiled and explained that it wasn't about losing hope, but rather a chance to finally visit the magical destinations we've always talked about exploring together... I understand her illness is serious, but as long as it brings her happiness, I'll support her wholeheartedly. And me? Well, I'm not one to give up without a fight.

April 15
Fuling asked me to map out our journey, and she took on the task of delving into success stories of her illness, pinpointing potential treatment spots. A few of the locations she picked were incredibly isolated. I was worried she wouldn't make it to those places. However, she brushed off my concerns with a carefree assurance, claiming she was perfectly capable and full of vigor.
Not wanting to dampen her spirits, I agreed and promised to take good care of her.

May 1
The famous doctor we visited in Mingting said she couldn’t do anything about Fuling's rare symptoms.
It's okay; we have other options. There must be a way to cure her.

May 30
Despite everything we've tried, we haven't found a treatment that can fully cure Fuling. Her condition has worsened, and the illness has made it difficult for her to travel long distances. To cheer her up, I rented a hologram projector from the Pioneer Association for her. She enjoyed the projected scenery, but I couldn’t ignore the yearning and sorrow in her eyes. She concealed them well, but I sensed them, and it pained my heart.

June 13
Fuling, in her gentle way, had requested snapshots of the landscapes I stumbled upon during my travels. She believed that by seeing these images, she could somehow accompany me on my journey. Despite her well-meaning gesture to console me, her absence left a void that tainted even the most breathtaking views with melancholy.

June 15
Encountered a Tacet Field on my path today, diverting me onto a detour that led me to a hidden lake nestled deep within the forest. 
The sight before me was beyond words—the wind carried petals from the trees, creating a mesmerizing dance of colors in the sky. My camera failed to capture the fleeting magic of that moment. Enthralled by the enchanting view, I momentarily lost touch with reality. 
Yet, as quickly as joy enveloped me, sorrow and fear washed over, realizing that such beauty held no meaning without her presence beside me. 
It felt like fate as I journeyed in search of a cure for Fuling, passing through places we had once dreamt of exploring together. Some spots were meant to surprise her during our planned adventures. 
If only Fuling were here, her artistic touch would breathe life into these places once more; even the most desolate ruins would flourish under her paintbrush.
...If only she were here with me.

June 16
I encountered a strange man in red today. His pretentious attitude put me on edge. Despite my unease, he shared a weird story with me, almost as if it was intentional.
He knew I was seeking a cure for Fuling and claimed to have a way to save her. However, he only revealed half the truth and insisted on me doing him a favor before sharing more details. Honestly, I'm not sure if I should trust him.

June 17
My next destination is Jinzhou, the home of a painter Fuling admired. She is so excited about this. I haven't seen her like this in a long time.
I've discovered the true identity of that man in red. Apparently, he belongs to a dangerous organization that I shouldn't meddle with, but...

June 20
The information shared by that man and his organization was beyond anything I could have imagined. The truth behind that tale, the Sentinel's power to manipulate time, the secret realm in Mt. Firmament... if they are all real, then Fuling can be cured.
According to the deal I made with them, I need to use my identity as an adventurer to find a certain object hidden in the mountain, and this object, as they promised, is the key to saving Fuling's life. They seemed unusually obsessed with it, but their intentions were none of my concern. All I need to do is keep Fuling alive, and for that, I'll pay any price.
I must give it a try.
Fuling's Letter

My Dearest Wuli,

How are you? I wonder if you're still continuing our adventure as you read these words.

You've visited several places on our list of future adventures. I intentionally picked them under the guise of seeking treatment for my illness, as you may have noticed. I wish I could go with you, Wuli… I don't have many days left, but I trust you'll find and enjoy the wonders we once dreamed of sharing.

We've traveled through diverse lands, witnessing lives rebuilding from devastation, and immortalizing extraordinary moments for a wider audience to savor. In this world scarred by the Lament, beauty and hope persist, sprouting anew from the depths of despair. This is our quest, and I hope you will carry this essence with you as your journey unfolds.

Our adventures have always been shared with companions. We met, journeyed together for a time, and eventually diverged onto separate paths. Perhaps we will reunite on our next escapade, or perhaps destiny will guide us on divergent routes indefinitely. The bravery to explore and forge ahead will forever reside within us.

This truth holds for our past journey and for the ones ahead for you.

The day will inevitably come when we must bid each other farewell, just as it will when our paths cross once more. So, my love, please, continue your journey... and carry our joint aspirations into the future.

With all my love,
Fuling

My new apprentice’s Forte of Flame Manipulation is crucial for destroying the Sonoro Sphere, a task that only she can accomplish. On the other hand, my old friend is the only one who can unlock said Sonoro Sphere. Both individuals are vital to the success of our goal. Yet, unleashing the full power of Flame Manipulation would exact a toll far too heavy for a mere child to endure.

It seems this game shall stay unfinished for many moons to come.

It suddenly dawns on me that I've been copying her paintings for over a year now. I've employed the same rendering technique, the same wrinkle method, and the same composition. Yet, my paintings lack her vividness, their visions unsteady as well. My Forte mirrors hers closely, only that her work conjures more vibrant and stable visions. I could achieve the same. Once I manage to conjure visions with the same vividness, people will recognize me as the best painter!
...

Mr. Baici, a man who has collaborated with numerous renowned artists, came to visit me. He had heard that I, too, could create paintings that summon vivid illusions. He came to express his admiration and encouraged me to continue. At first, I thought someone had finally recognized my talent. But his true intention was to recruit me into his shady business, buying all Forte works for dubious purposes. I had heard of the Shanyun Art Exchange, but never imagined their dealings would be so unscrupulous. While I did copy those paintings for practice, the choice of what and how to paint was mine alone. These dealers think they can buy me—what a joke.
...

The Shanyun Art Exchange sent me an authentic painting so I could study the vision's frequency. They claim they have superior methods to help me achieve the desired effect if my own Forte fall short. My Forte is not inferior to hers. They simply haven’t seen its full potential. Yet, with the authentic work in hand, progress would indeed be swifter.
Their condition is that I collaborate with them and hand over all my copies. These paintings are mere stepping stones to my success, destined to be discarded. So, why not accept their terms? I don't care what they do with the paintings. They assure me they've been conducting such transactions for years without incident. With such a powerful patron, there should be no trouble.
I'll do anything to make it happen.
...

Having an authentic work in my hands makes all the difference. The frequency fluctuations of the painting have allowed me to glimpse her energy. I need to examine her original painting once more. A perfect replica is just the beginning. One day, I will be the only painter capable of bringing paintings to life, surpassing even her achievements.
...

Why do my paintings still fall short after all this time? They lack her artistic depth! Wait—I think I understand. If I use their method to alter the painting's frequency, I might be able to achieve it...
...

Mr. Baici is truly a connoisseur of art. He says my recent works are nearly indistinguishable from the original. Some have even exhibited power beyond the original piece. I knew it. The gap between us is merely a slight difference in ability. With their technical support, my Forte has easily reached the next level. Surpassing her should be simple, let alone mere replication.
...

No, something is wrong... Why do my paintings attract Tacet Discords? The visions are more unstable now. How is it that her painting has none of these problems? There's something amiss here. I... I just want to surpass her! I never meant to harm anyone! The Shanyun Art Exchange is still not giving me a clear answer... This was not our deal!
...

I'm tired, truly, deeply tired...
I won't create any more paintings that harm others.
This isn't what I wanted!
But they have evidence of what I've done and won't let me go...
What should I do? What should I do?
Can anyone help me... anybody...
I’m not afraid of being caught anymore... As long as I can get out of this...
Help me...

//By Bram
I have seen my end. Before death arrives, I... must repent.
I am not a pure scholar.
I envy my colleagues... Victor, Alaia, Vasily, Chen Xuefeng... They all have ideals, and beliefs. They sincerely hope that their efforts will better humanity. They want to surmount the Lament and ward off crises.
I am different. I work for selfish reasons, masquerading my ambition as ideals like theirs. I joined the research on Retroact Rain in Whining Aix's Mire and then relocated to Mt. Firmament, all to prove that time is a river. We are merely carried along by it and someday we will also find a way to go against the current.
Like a drowning man, I grasped at any straw, seeking salvation where none exists... Isn't it ridiculous, Vivian?
I don't know why I have you in my mind at this moment... Or should I say... you never left. The miracles at Mt. Firmament once fueled my unrealistic fantasies. I sacrificed everything and exhausted all the knowledge I had acquired throughout my life, just to bring you back from the dark, hazy underworld, and hold you in my arms once again.
But I failed. My fingers started to tremble, my head grew dizzy, and I could no longer operate those delicate instruments. I see you now, standing by the river, separated from me only by a thin veil. I've been drifting down, and down, and down... But you, you stayed somewhere upstream, for eternity.
Fortunately, I won't have to worry about this much longer. I'm about to run aground, and I hope I have the chance to sail upstream and find you.

Date: [––]
Testing, testing… Ah, great! So the recording function still works.
I, Victor Christopher, the last Research Director, am leading this experiment in my own name—no precedent, no animal tests, no ethical reviews. Honestly, making the decision was torture to me—my science ethics is wearing thin. But none of those were possible. I'm running out of time. It's just me and Caleb, that assistant AI, now.
Still, I'm recording what I'm about to do. I'm not recording in proper formatting, 'cause this is but a desperate act by an unresigned old man. I hope this won't bother anyone who should find this memo.
I've set up a few Chronopins—to prevent energy breakdown, I'll overload each of them—which should, theoretically, create a lasting, irreversible time bubble, trapping me inside like an insect in amber. I hesitate to call it immortality—it's more like sentencing myself to life. The only comfort is that my consciousness will be kept still too, so I'll stay sane during this long slumber.
The reason I'm doing this instead of welcoming death with calm is… I have to wait for that one's return.
That one once helped us develop the technology of [data corrupted], helped us reconstruct what was a tiny chip of the Sentinel's supreme power. They showed us a glimpse of a god's world, even if just for an instant. And I just… want to meet that one again, even though they might not give us the answers we long for.
By then, what will that one say to this foolish, dying old man? Will they call me a complete idiot? Will that one compare our research to child's play, with that scorn theirs? Or will they appreciate our work... before our tombs?
I don't know. It's been too long. My memory of that one has blurred. The only part about them that's left in mind is that they were so caring, and so indifferent, at once.
Okay, it's about time. Gotta get in my amber. I'll see you in a million years, my friends, or in a few seconds… They're the same to me.

Date: [---].
I am Victor. This is a routine voice journal.
Today is another beautiful day. Most of the researchers have left. They will leave Mt. Firmament. Mr. Bram and I advised them to calm down and at least wait until we resolve the issue of shortened lifespan before making a decision. But they didn't listen.
I didn't leave. Research requires perseverance, which was the first lesson Mr. Bram taught me. He always leads by example. Ha, to him, I'll always be that immature young boy.
Date: [---].
I took some time to create something new: a simple AI. I named it Caleb after the iron-headed thing who traveled with a man and dog in an old movie I watched as a kid. Not many people are left here, so someone has to take care of the minor work. An AI is always useful.
I also created some interesting rock puzzles, powered by the many unoccupied Chronosorters in this place. It reminds me of playing with building blocks in my childhood. Those were the days. However, Mr. Bram doesn't seem very happy. Maybe his age prevents him from accepting too many new things...? Or perhaps his worsening leg condition makes these rock puzzles a hassle for him to navigate.
I don't mind. Life isn't just about work and research, right?
Date: [---].
It is quite enjoyable to educate an AI from scratch. It's like painting on a blank canvas—I need to stay focused to avoid turning a meticulous artwork into a careless scribble.
I answer any questions it raises and write new database entries for it every few days. I teach it everything I know about the world, using the methods Mr. Bram taught me. This feeling... is wonderful. Its camera reflects the world as I see it, and it thinks with my logic, allowing me to examine myself again through its actions.
Date: [---].
Caleb learns quite quickly. Initially, I only intended for it to help with cooking and tidying up the facility. I never expected its potential to far exceed our imagination. It seems that it is time to change its title from "Life Assistant" to "Research Assistant".
Mr. Bram has been ill for several days, bedridden, and unable to go anywhere. I miss the energetic man who used to scold us apprentices one by one. But now I have become a middle-aged man myself, too. It's been days since I last shaved, but it seems trivial now.
Date: [---].
Mr. Bram… didn't make it through that long winter.
Caleb and I buried him on a hill nearby without a tombstone. It wouldn't help anyway, as no one will know who we are or what our names are. People might just laugh about how a bunch of lunatics indulge themselves in illusions when they see our negligible legacy.
Caleb was with Mr. Bram until his very last moment. And Mr. Bram… taught it everything he knew. I understand why.
I once read a story about a man who was determined to level a mountain, despite everyone thinking he was out of his mind. But he made it, with the help of his sons, his grandsons, his great-grandsons, and so on.
I hope Caleb will shoulder this responsibility. I've told it about this. Human life is too short, but Caleb is immortal. It might accomplish what is impossible for us.
I will not live to see that day, but I will do everything I can while I'm alive to press forward. I promise, in the name of Bram, my mentor.

Why would Tethys incorporate such a complex logic structure?

...There are too many mysteries and no answers. I can only document what I've discovered, but beyond that, I am powerless...

Codex of the Deep: Preface (137th Edition)

Codex of the Deep: Preface (137th Edition) Many non-initiates misunderstand the Order of Deep and feel overwhelmed by words in the Codex such as "grace," "salvation," "mercy," and "faith." Indeed, never has the Sentinel Imperator revealed Their true form. So why then, are we to believe in Their existence? The chronicles of Rinascita record numerous battles of the Sentinel against the Lament. The ruins and wonders across Rinascita bear witness to Imperator's divine authority. Their destined path created a better world for mankind, leaving us to shape a new future, while They, silently watch over us. We are grateful for Their blessings. We honor Their teachings. We follow in Their deeds by disseminating wisdom that guides all towards good—such is the mission of the Order of Deep. Under Cassilin the Knowledgeable, we have compiled this introduction to elucidate upon the meaning of the Sentinel and our Order. This we hope inspires followers on the path of virtue. We begin with some frequently asked questions: 1. Who is Sentinel Imperator? Sentinel Imperator embodies peace, justice, modesty, and mercy. It is important to note that we acknowledge other divine beings, for They have spoken of Sentinels in distant lands, with powers that control day and night, the flow of time, or all knowledge and wisdom. Without exception, all Sentinels selflessly guide humanity and shepherd civilization. As such, all Sentinels are great divinities. However We believe Sentinel Imperator holds foremost power to "Split." That is, They split the ocean, granting humanity land on which to "breathe." By right of Their providence, Imperator is elevated among all Sentinels. 2. What is the Order's doctrine? This mortal world is a boundless sea in which every soul must swim up to the divine. Life flows in waves, and only by reaching the shore do we reach the dawn of civilization. Our Sentinel is salvation from the gales and tides, is the unity from which Rinascita was born, and is ascension for our souls. The Order's doctrines are thus: “Salvation," "Ascension," and "Unity." - Salvation: By the grace of the Sentinel, Their followers must deliver salvation to others. Nary are we blind to injustice or suffering. We labor to save others from sin. To the wicked, the Order provides salvation, and for the unrepentant, may we exact penitence. - Ascension: To find salvation is to seek ascension. Members of the Order will not indulge Their favor in idle pleasures or desires. All must elevate their spirit through self-discipline or risk sinking into the abyss. - Unity: After granting us Their representation on earth, Sentinel Imperator left Rinascita in our care. Members of the Order are "brothers and sisters," who unite people of faith, regardless of origin or background. Only as one can we fortify ourselves from the perils of the deep sea. The first Primus, Napoli the Second, received a prophecy from the Sentinel: in a distant future, a "Last Wave" shall engulf the earth. Those saved must "breathe," to "ascend" in "unity" on new land, just as we once answered the Sentinel's call and made landfall on Rinascita. 3. Is there evidence to support the doctrine of the Order? Theology is a science humanity has not yet fully understood in theory or practice. The Sentinel guides civilization, and we trust Their word. Throughout the generations, the Order has established the following philosophical precepts. Excerpts from The Philosophy of the Order: Sacred Knowledge (Volume 1: Water): On Origin: Genesis in "Water." In nature "Water" is infinite as it is universal. In the beginning, Sentinel Imperator "split" this world, once a formless ocean, into the realm of land and sea. On Motion: Movement through "Water." The motion of "Water" heats and cools, wets and dries the realm of land. From water, all life was created in the "First Wave" and will end in the "Last Wave." On Revelations: Refractions of "Water." Man's image reflected by "Water" is a strange reality unto himself. So too applies to all reality when water refracts the world unto the Sonoro Sphere. Through reforms by successive Primuses, we have come to emphasize the scientific and practical application of our philosophical understanding. Readers may visit Arito Well in the Square of Liberty to experience the mysteries of "water divination": toss a coin into the well, make a heartfelt wish, and answers you shall receive. We would be greatly honored if this Codex engenders interest in the Sentinel's teachings, and we welcome all to the Order's library, where supplementary literature is available to borrow. While words are a paltry means to express the Sentinel's grand purpose, we nonetheless hope to have adequately conveyed fractions of divine essence. Let miracles recorded in the Codex be "symbols" of infinite, communicable power. Through narratives of common understanding, we envision a world of unwavering faith. Even as the Lament threatens to return, we reaffirm our place and purpose. We pray that believers and non-believers alike will view the text herein as an invitation for communion and reflection. May these words offer insight to us adrift at sea. The paths are many, but with virtue in our hearts, we illuminate a way amidst the waves.

Day 16.

The pilgrimage chapel is nothing but another empty shell. The knights smashed windows and overturned altars, but not one sign of the relic has been found.

Renzo seems to have lost his wits, staring at the torches and babbling—perhaps a result of the drowning earlier. We can't afford to wait for his recovery. Ennio wishes to keep him with us, but such sentiment would only slow us down.

Our cause allows no room for the weak. Now, a ruin lies to the <color=Highlight>west</color> of this island. That shall be our next destination.

May we walk ever upon the righteous path.

Day 17.

We waded through marshland to reach this waterlogged ruin, only to find more disappointment. The knights are losing faith—some doubt we'll ever find this so-called relic. Ennio, who's as close as family to me, stood against my decision to move on. He accused me of straying from the righteous path.

There was no other way to settle it; we dueled, as the knight's creed demands. He cast the gauntlets over to me, his mentor. Our duel ended amidst a strange howl from afar. When he fell, a part of me fell with him.

Ennio... He was set on the ideals of knighthood but was blind to the cold reality facing our branch of the family. I can feel it now—fortune and glory lie to the <color=Highlight>north</color>. Porto-Veno Castle will have to honor our deeds.

At this point, there's no turning back.

(The edges of the yellowed page are charred)

Day ██.

Our search stretched on and on, and all we found in the storeroom was a worn-out weapon schematic, probably left behind by the Order. Silently, we gathered anything of worth, not speaking a word about the relic. No one needed to—everyone knew. This quest has failed, and all our sacrifice has been in vain. But I don't accept it. The Order must have hidden something here on this island. Where is it?

(Rushed handwriting follows as if penned in great urgency)

Those damned TDs are coming for us. It's only a matter of time before they break through. But I've finally found it.

How absurd! The relic was always here, right before our eyes.

At the grand altar of ██, circled by towering Tacetites.

The howls are drawing closer. Forgive me.

The aromatic fat from the grilled fish glistens as it drips down, adding to the flames of the campfire below.

Mmm! The fat has infused the fish beautifully, and if you savor each bite, you can still taste the freshness of the fish itself. Delicious! A perk of being a fisherman, I'd say!

Nothing slips past you, does it, Joanna? A few days ago, I was actually thinking about quitting. It gets too lonely traveling alone. The Haven's scenery here is stunning, and I thought about building a hut here and waiting to die of old age. Last night, you found your way into my dreams...

Don't worry, I've nearly forgotten your face and your voice. What I haven't forgotten is the promise you made. The one about moving forward and seeing unseen views.

Besides fish, there are so many other delicacies I haven't had the chance to try yet, and places I want to visit. I can't just let it end like this. I'll set off at first light tomorrow.

Winter is here. Time to take a break and use this time to sharpen my sword skills.
Speaking of which, I met a couple of knights today. They seem to have come here drawn by the legends, hoping to continue their quests from Whisperwind Haven.
Each of them bore a family crest on their armor. It was easy to learn their identities. "In the name of the family, I shall..."
I'm sorry I lied to you, Joanna. Korlacchi. The holy name... doesn't exist. Because of the snowstorm, I was not able to attend the banquet where they were recruiting household knights.
That name, I only borrowed it from a novel about knighthood I found on a dusty shelf... I was never granted knighthood...
Forgive me...
House Painter's Secret List

Tonight's banquet is a big deal. It's my first time handling something this important. The higher-ups even had me and Barolo set the password for the lighting controls. But how do I make sure everything goes according to plan? Aha, I've got it—keep the enemies close, just like with secrets. For the <color=yellow>first two digits</color>... I'll go with the <color=yellow>number of trees and chandeliers in the hall</color>. As for the last two digits, that's on Barolo. He took forever setting up the balloons in the hall yesterday. Maybe he was hiding the password in the <color=yellow>balloons</color>? Ugh... still feels a bit off. Better go check everything again.
A Memo with No Important Info

You know, as you get older, your memory starts to slip... But here's the good news—I'm only in charge of the last two digits for the light control password. Well, I'll just go with August 9th. It's an important day for me—it's my wedding anniversary with my dear Mathilde, and also the day Padrino baptized our Charlotte. <color=yellow>August 9th</color> it is, then. Perfect for the last digits of the password.
A Letter Written on Torn Paper

My dear boy,
 
Leaving you is the last thing I want, but these troubled times force my hand. All I can offer now are a few words on this torn paper.

Stand tall and live your life with pride. Your parents gave their lives for the dignity of art, and you carry the same blood in your veins.

I've sacrificed my freedom in pursuit of the endless mysteries these Echoes hold, but I believe in you—you have a strong heart. Hold on to hope and keep moving forward.

One day, the treasure we have valued deep within the Averardo Vault will bring forth new hope.

With Love,
Ash
