Should we split up?
Do we have any other leads?
Easy there, young one. There’s a clue that could help us locate Linghan swiftly.
Now that you mention it, something just jogged my memory. It might help us locate Linghan swiftly.

Nếu trí nhớ của tôi không nhầm thì cô ấy hẳn đang thu thập Echo of Flautist. Với sức khỏe của mình, cô ấy sẽ không mạo hiểm đến Tacet Fields, vì vậy cô ấy phải khám phá thế giới hoang dã để tìm ra những mối bất hòa Tacet rải rác.
In our day, we relied on experience to locate Tacet Discords, but I’ve heard there are more advanced technologies available now.
Yep! The gourd just got upgraded with a search function. Let’s see if we can use it to spot any nearby Tacet Discords.
Let me try...
How to use it?

Don’t worry, {PlayerName}, it’s pretty straightforward. Normally, I’d give you time to figure it out yourself, but with Grandma Linghan missing, we can’t afford to waste any. Let me walk you through it.
You got it! I’ll be your guide through this.
Whoa, this new tech is amazing! We found her in no time flat.
Let’s not dawdle. Hang tight, Linghan! We’re on our way!
This place is seriously dangerous. Grandma Linghan isn’t in a good health condition. Why would she come here...
She must be here to collect the Echo of Flautist. After all, today is... a special day.
What special day?
Many years ago on this very day, Jinzhou was besieged by a fierce Tacet Discord outbreak. Tens of Midnight Rangers stood firm on the front lines, confronting thousands of Tacet Discords.
It was Linghan who proposed a brilliant strategy. With her deep understanding of Echoes, she suggested utilizing them to repel the enemies’ assault.
To minimize casualties, she led the entire squad here to gather hundreds of Flautist’s Echoes.
She was also a Midnight Ranger?
Yes...
Hey, isn't that person with the silver hair over there...? Grandma Linghan! GRANDMA LINGHAN! Over here!
Darn! She’s too far away to hear us!
No! The Tacet Discords are closing in on her!
Oh, man! We can’t even use overdashing to catch up from this distance!
Leave it to me!
Frostbite Tortoise, I choose you! Protect Linghan!
Phew! That was a close call!
Let’s take this chance...!
Your observation is sharp, young one. You have the makings of a soldier. Now is the moment to strike! Seize the opportunity given by the lull in Flautist’s attacks!
Let’s go!
Phew... Finally safe.
Young ones, are you alright?
W-We’re fine! Just needed to catch our breath after that crazy moment...
Instead of worrying us, go make sure Grandma Linghan’s okay!
Linghan, how are you feeling? Any injuries? Does it hurt?
Your Echo is Frostbite Tortoise, isn’t it?
You’ve raised it well, and the timing couldn’t be more perfect.
Linghan...
Seeing your Echo reminds me of my dear...
He shielded our entire squad with a humble Frostbite Tortoise, time and time again.
At first, everyone mocked him for choosing such a seemingly feeble Echo. Yet, they were all silenced by its might in the end.
After all, the strength of an Echo lies in the hands of its user.
I see. My judgment was clouded by strength before, capturing Echoes purely based on their appearances. You're right. You're always right.
Grandpa Jingzhu, why are you crying?
These tears... They’re tears of joy.
By the way, there’s a striking resemblance between you and my dear...
Both with a nose and two eyes, quite similar indeed, hehe.
But you’re nowhere near as handsome as him. In my eyes, he was incomparable—wise and brave beyond measure.
Y-Your cataracts seem to be worsening...
Hurry up! Get her reacquainted with you!
You’re right! Captain Linghan, it’s a pleasure to make your acquaintance. Allow me to introduce myself. I’m a member of the Vanguard of Midnight Rangers. You can call me Jingzhu.
Jingzhu... Did you just have flowers with you?
Oh yeah! I was too busy dealing with the Tacet Discords, and I dropped them somewhere.
Let me get them for you!
They’re right here. Let’s take them back to Grandpa Jingzhu!
Here, this Noctemint is for you. Please accept it, Linghan. Will you once again be my lifelong companion?
Ah, the scent of Noctemint... it’s so familiar. My dear used to bring me Noctemints. Just a whiff would lift my spirits.
Flowers, Echoes... they’re all the same. Practicality is key.
Y-Yes! From this moment onward, I’ll be by your side, soaking in the sunshine, engaging in conversation... Whatever you desire, I’ll be there with you!
As long as I can be by your side!
Because I made a promise to you, Linghan. I vowed to never let you be alone, and I intend to uphold that promise for eternity.
But alas, we can’t soak up the sun here.
Escort me back. Basking in the sun on my doorstep is where I feel most at ease.
Alright, alright, let’s go home!
Grandpa Jingzhu, where is Grandma Linghan?
Linghan isn’t in a good health condition, so I’ve let her return to rest for now.
Such a relief to hear that! I’m so glad she got home safe.
Oh, and by the way, I’ve got a ton of questions. {PlayerName}, you too, right?
Yes...
You might have noticed already: Linghan was once an exceptional Midnight Ranger, serving as the captain of the Vanguard.
She wasn’t just my captain; she's also my beloved wife, with whom I’ve shared many years...
Being captain, she had a lot on her plate, always leading the charge, protecting our squad, and teaching us survival skills.
As the battles escalated, she pushed herself beyond limits and suffered grave injuries.
After a major victory, she eventually fell ill. She started to feel mentally foggy, causing her memories to slowly fade away.
She forgot how to navigate the streets of Jinzhou, forgot to eat her favorite Helmet Flatbread while they were still warm, and then...
She even forgot about me...
So, that’s why you’ve been chasing after Grandma Linghan, huh?
You’re hoping to stick by her side as her special someone.
Yes, you’re correct. Our comrades, once vibrant youths, perished in battle, while others succumbed to illness.
I can’t help but fear that someday if she were to regain her memories, she’d feel a profound loneliness... I cannot bear the thought.
Sorry for bringing up sad things. Thank you for helping me find Linghan.
Linghan has accepted me. It’s a great joy! I should feel happy!
The past is the past. From now on, I’ll treasure every moment shared with Linghan!
Exactly! Let’s treasure every moment and live life to the max!
Hehe, if you have time, feel free to visit us, and we can chat about Echoes to our heart’s content.
I can’t express my gratitude enough for your assistance in resolving this matter.
Plus, seeing you must have made Linghan so relieved to know that the people we risked our lives for have turned into amazing adults.
Thank you for your efforts. Here are what you deserve.
Besides the compensation, this old man has a word of advice for you.
Take good care of your Echoes. The world beyond can be perilous, and they may come in handy in times of need.
To safeguard yourselves and those dear to you.
Wait, who turned this on?
It's the first time I see its screen glow...
Really?! LET ME SEE!
That's weird—Oh, {PlayerName}! Didn't expect to see you here!
You know me?
What are we looking at?
You kidding? How could I not recognize the Academy's living legend!
Check this out. This arcade cabinet has been sitting here since my very first day of school. I've never seen it on before.
But its screen is actually live today!
Let's see...
You lean in and find a line of text emerging from the center of the screen.
"Attention faculty and students! Welcome to the world of Star Bouncing. Log in with your Persona Pinball and start a brand-new adventure!"
Looks interesting.
Hm, you gonna give it a try?

The arcade stands before you, its screen flickering with a rhythmic glow, almost like it's breathing. You get the strange impression that a single touch will pull you into an entirely different world.
Sure. Why not?
Ah, {PlayerName}. You finished it faster than I expected. Never let people down, hm?
Why do I see disappointment on your face now?
Care to explain all this, Madam President?
That's too much of a word. I know someone as sharp and smart as you would clear this game in no time. But isn't it normal to be a bit emotional when you finally finish a game?
Well, it's just a little game I made on a whim.
And don't worry, its underlying structure is completely safe.
It just brings your hidden persona to the surface for a while. Pretty funny, isn't it?
...True.

Well, even I find myself craving something fresh to break up the daily grind every now and then. And honestly, with so many brilliant students around, I never have to look far for a spark of inspiration.
So adding Rainbow Bean Pop Rocks into the game was also part of your plan?
It works like a catalyst. Otherwise, the game would be far too boring and bland.
And Dr. Luuk?
That's none of my business. He signed up for it himself.
He volunteered to make sure everything stayed under control. Makes sense to me. It's his invention, after all.
Mornye also helped work on the theories, though only a tiny part during the initial phase before she got buried under a mountain of student essays...
Sounds like another prank managed by the sly faculty together.
Ouch. No need to be so harsh. It was just an academic collaboration.
So, you did all this... just to let me have a try?
Exactly. You get to experience something different—reactions or personalities you don't normally get to see.
What's your verdict? A funny little surprise, I hope?
It's not bad.
What if I say no?
Haha. I'm glad you liked it.
Hmm... then I'll have to try something else next time.
I hope you did find a bit of unusual fun in this little interlude, {PlayerName}.
Welcome to this Relay Station!
Just ask if you need assistance using the station facilities. I am here to help.
On a field expedition, safety comes first. Everyone open your internship handbooks. I'll keep this brief.
Ironhoofs have such a reassuring presence... I wish I could keep one too.
Well... I'll be here for some time. Come and visit it, whenever you wish.
I've hit a roadblock lately. Would it be possible to borrow an Exoswarm for some experiments?
Don't be silly! Do you even know the extent of the procedures required to involve an Exoswarm in an experiment?
I've hit a roadblock in my research. Think I could... borrow an Exoswarm for some experiments?
Silly goose! Do you have any idea the amount of red tape you need to cut through to get an Exoswarm for an experiment?
I really don't, but I'm all ears.
First, you gotta write up your whole proposal, especially the part about why you need the Exoswarm, and submit it to your advisor.
If your advisor approves, they write a recommendation and send the whole packet to the Head of Division.
Next, the Head of Division and the Department Director will...
Whoa! Please stop, it's making me dizzy. I give up!
Actually, I'm interested in the process. Please go on.
Now that's the spirit! Now, where was I... Right, the Department Director!
Once the Director thinks an Exoswarm is justified, they send it to the Academic Committee. They'll call a meeting with all the different Department Directors to review everything.
If you pass that, you're done with the academics. Then comes the administrative side.
The Chief of General Affairs contacts the Royan representative here. Then you, with your Department Director, have to present your research to them in person.
If the Royan rep gives the thumbs-up, they'll present your report to the Solisylum. Don't worry, the rep is always a top academic. They won't mess it up.

If Solisylum agrees it's necessary, then things get easier. But then there's the actual logistics of transporting the Exoswarm, and the list of do's and don'ts while researching it... Well, that's a whole other story.
Just hearing the process shows how important Exoswarm are to Lahai-Roi.
That was actually interesting to hear. Thanks for explaining.
Exoswarm are able to adapt well to Lahai-Roi's complex and varied terrain.
Wouldn't it be great if we could borrow a few to help with our field research?
My big brother barely ever comes home since he left for his studies. I miss him so much.
Could you carry me across the Academy's walls to see my brother?
If I place a plant into a mech reindeer's mouth, it will be processed and synthesized within its body, right?
I'd just call it eating and digesting. Except what comes out... is raw materials.
I can't believe it! A band of Outcasts disguised themselves as ordinary Roya and scammed me!
Oh? Well, even a three-year-old Roya is scarily smart, let alone a grown Outcast.
Am I just imagining it? I swear the food here tastes way better than at any other station.
Don't you see all the Roya around us? It's all thanks to them!
Am I just imagining it? I swear the food here tastes way better than at any other station.
Don't you see all the Roya around us? It's all thanks to them!
There are two Roya camps nearby. This is their usual rest stop.
They couldn't stand our cooking, so they stepped in and tweaked a few things themselves.
No way! This is so good, I'm almost tempted to switch my research focus to Royan cuisine.
First time this far out for an internship? Got the jitters?
I got totally lost back in my day. Seriously thought that was it for me.
"Brief," he said. It's been going on for at least 30 minutes now...
First time this far out for an internship? Got the jitters?
I got totally lost back in my day. Seriously thought that was it for me.
But then, this Royan woman appeared. She had a staff, a Mining Reindeer by her side, with the Reactor's glow shining behind her... She just grinned at me.
I wouldn't have made it without her. So, remember the social etiquette taught in Royan Culture lectures. Be respectful. It pays off.
Finally, my last stop for the day.
I should reward myself with some Royan cuisine after a day like this.
I have some tools made from Exoswarm material. Would you like one?
For real? Wait a sec... this doesn't seem right. What did they say about this in Royan Culture lectures again...?
What do you think about this spot? Nice and quiet, right?
Are you blind? Who would be stupid enough to rob a Spacetrek Collective station?
Beware of rapid currents and hazards in the wilds.
Visitors to the Solstream Cascade, please do not cross beyond the station's safe zone.
You're joking, right?
I wish. A bunch of Soliskin just made off with my expedition motorbike.
You're joking, right?
I wish. A bunch of Soliskin just made off with my expedition motorbike.
Please... tell me everything in detail.
I parked on a high ridge and hiked down on foot to collect some data.
Suddenly, I heard the engine start. I turned around and saw my motorbike being dragged to the other side of the hill.
Next thing I know, there's this group of round, chubby, glowing little things... just bouncing all over my bike. It was so bizarre, I just froze.
I see. I wish I was the one to see some Soliskin riding on a motorbike. Bet it was adorable.
Sure, I'll regret not getting a picture for the rest of my life. But think you can help get it back?
By the time I snapped out of it, they were already wobbling away on it.
Oh, we'll contact the Roya at the nearby camp and ask one of their herders for help. When it comes to Soliskin, they're the ones you want.
Freeze! I'll send you back to the Academy! This is my turf!
I'm telling the station master!
You spent your time at Solstream Cascade doing serious research, right? Not just gawking, right?
I'm sure submitting a report and taking an exam right after we get back won't be a problem, right?
What?! U-Uh, you're not ready for it either, right?
I'm sure I'll... Ugh, fine. I was too busy taking selfies by the cascades.
Squeezy Jelly, check. Cans, check. Reactor light spectrum measuring toolkit, check.
Next was... What was next again? Hmm... uh, Squeezy Jelly? Check.
The Cradle Lichen here is flourishing! Looks a lot better than what the Agro Wing is growing.
There aren't many plants here, but they're all huge. Look at that massive bed of Lichen!
We're not here to admire the cascades! We need to hurry up and collect the environmental data.
This trip was worth it! Solstream Cascade lives up to the hype!
How are you so chill? Are you sure we won't get caught for skipping class?
Ugh, lost again. I still can't wrap my head around all these rules.
You just need more practice. And not just against me.
Ugh, lost again. I still can't wrap my head around all these rules.
You just need more practice. And not just against me.
Every night, a whole crowd gathers at the Howling Tunnel to play Peaks of Prestige. It's like the Exostrider's own whispers are the wind... the atmosphere is unreal.
Oh? It sounds worth checking out. I'll go one of these days.
Solstream Cascade shines with a new light now.
Solstream Cascade shines with a new light now.
You're one of the Heliodic Six..
I am the Binder. To the Reactor Drive, I am observer and keeper. Are you the Arbiter who aided the New Solar Ceremony? My gratitude, you have.
Today, the light upon the world... is known as Helios. My heart's shadows are swept away in its brilliance.
So beautiful. So warm. A tenderness in which I now abide.
Please convey my thanks to its creator. And may your path ahead be ever clear.
I'm an indoor person... Or maybe you can call me a lab-person.
Being forced to be outside for an internship is torture to me.
All my husband ever thinks about is his research. He even talks in his sleep about the lab.
Mine's no better. Always off doing stuff for the Solsworn, never any time for things at home.
Sundermere is a research site. Please leave immediately if you are not a member of this station.
If you have entered the zone by mistake, please contact station staff immediately.
What? You want a posting here? You've got a long way to go.
Do you even know what Sundermere is? Focus on learning the Academy ropes first.
That's right. It was a night just like this one. I was deep in the Howling Tunnel collecting data.
And then, out of nowhere... this low hum filled the air, like a chorus of whispers...
You know the Twin Nova was built to explore what's beyond the Stridergate, right?
Of course. Nobody knows what it's really like out there.
You know the Twin Nova was built to explore what's beyond the Stridergate, right?
Of course. Nobody knows what it's really like out there.
The Spacetrek Collective needs combat robots that can operate on their own and pull off those high-G maneuvers.
When the day comes to launch, seeing the Twin Nova in that formation... it's gonna be a hell of a sight.
Is it me, or is the canned food here even worse than at the Research Institute?
If you ask the Academy's staff, they'll just blame it on Sundermere.
Hello! Is this the check-in? I'm so excited to be assigned to Sundermere Station!
Whoa, someone's eager. Gotta warn ya, it gets tough out here. Don't let it break ya.
Other places I've been to are nothing compared to this.
Yeah. But the higher-ups know this is way above our pay grade. Best not to think about it too much.
Another sleepless night?
I had a nightmare, and when I woke up, it felt like I could hear Ingles' screaming again.
You look rough. Another sleepless night?
Had a nightmare. Woke up feeling like I could hear Ingles screaming all over again.
That's just in your head... But you went ahead and pulled strings to get stationed here, of all places? Why? I know you can't get over your brother's death, but...
He kept saying everything would be fine once the Hyvatia Space Telescope was launched, and then he could finally rest...
It kills me that the moment he was waiting for... is the same one that killed him.
Void Storms are unpredictable. Ingles knew the risks when he signed up.
I know, but... his life's work is right there. And it's "alive" in a way he never imagined. The least I can do is be here to see it through to the end.
Who called Brissett in? We don't have any results to show yet!
The Institute was never sold on our project to begin with! We can't afford any more screw-ups!
Who called Brissett in? We don't have any results to show yet!
The Institute was never sold on our project to begin with! We can't afford any more screw-ups!
Well, we managed to talk our way out of it this time. Getting Brissett as our reviewer is actually a lucky break.
I know. He's reasonable. Anyone else would have slashed our funding to the bone the second they heard what we're studying.
The whistling in the Howling Tunnel... the Roya call it the "Exostrider's Craw." Multiple researchers, including Mr. Duarte, have reported auditory hallucinations.
And those who hear them... they claim it's the voices of people lost to the Void Storms.
If we can prove that, maybe we can find out where the missing ended up after the Void Storms took them!
The more we talk, the more I think this is the profitable angle. Next time I'm at the Institute, I'm applying for more funding.
Ugh, I need a transfer. I haven't seen the sun in weeks. Look at my skin!
Are you saying the Reactor Drive's light is good for your skin?
Could he have heard victims of the Void Storm speaking from beyond the grave...?
Duarte spins this yarn to every new batch of students.
He's so committed, he's almost got me believing it.
Ugh, I need a transfer. I haven't seen the sun in weeks. Look at my skin!
Are you saying the Reactor Drive's light is good for your skin?
Hehe, I'm only kidding. But that would be an interesting research topic.
Definitely sounds more promising than whatever they're doing here... Then again, their weird research does give us some cover for our own... operations.
True. But we'll need to get Brissett out of the way first, or that'll be difficult.
Aha! So does this waveform represent the "ooh" sound?
Who's shouting near the receiver? You're screwing up the data!
I heard the Apex Duelist from the birthplace of Peaks of Prestige has mastered every single deck!
No way! I haven't even finished learning all the cards yet.
A new player showed up and wiped the floor with all the local masters!
I heard that too! Slashed through them like the Exostrider's greatsword slicing through butter!
Wow! It's the Lahai-Roi reigning champion!
Good luck, champion of Lahai-Roi! I can't wait to see you play in the championship!
Wow... you even look like a champion. No wonder you're the best!
You've been playing too much Peaks of Prestige. Snap out of it!
Hmm... Didn't you swear you'd "never play again" after you lost this morning?
Details, details! Come on, just one more game!
You again? I told you not to come back until you get good!
Playing noobs is just going to hurt my game!
I agree with you completely! Go on, keep telling me how awesome I am!
Another challenger? I bet you won't last two rounds.
They're as based as an Ironhoof!
Nah, I think you mean to say Sabercat Prowler!
They're as based as an Ironhoof!
Nah, I think you mean to say Sabercat Prowler!
Every card they play is so scary! It's like facing an Ironhoof!
They play so fast I can't keep up! It's like they're a Sabercat Prowler!
Ironhoof!
Sabercat Prowler!
Sir, will the predicted Twilight Epoch really come to pass?
Given how many of the other predictions have already come true, what's the Royan perspective on the Twilight Epoch?
Sir, will the predicted Twilight Epoch really come to pass?
Given how many of the other predictions have already come true, what's the Royan perspective on the Twilight Epoch?
Oh? You ask about the Trine Myth? Rare it is to find curious ears.
I guess we're a rare breed. Hazel and I were captivated by how the epic scenes in the predictions align with reality. We started a fan club, but after all these months, it's still just the two of us.
We thought the Royan students would be interested and tried inviting them. Got rejected every time!
Blame them not. They have heard those stories since they were babes in the cradle.
But the Twilight Epoch tells us that our end will not be one of unstoppable doom. It will be an opportunity to stand with Baldur and fight against Hvedrungr!
Whether it is outsiders to Lahai-Roi like the two of you, or the Heliodic Six, there are those who prepare for the Twilight Epoch's arrival.
If you ask what I believe, it is this: Lahai-Roi will weather the Twilight Epoch. It will find its way into the new era beyond it.
Sir, your words... I haven't felt this moved since I first read the Trine Myth!
Right! We'll double our efforts! We'll recruit more members, upgrade to a full society so that more people will see how incredible the Trine Myth is!
You are both students, first and foremost. Do not let your studies fall behind.
And just as the Sacred Reactor Epoch foretold, forgotten the past, many of my people have. They do not worry about the future.

Field research, infrastructure projects, and exchanges between the Roya and the Spacetrek Collective all rely on a solid transportation network.
That's us! We provide transportation services for people and goods across the entire region.

But thanks to our Royan partners, some stations are now serving even tastier meals!

Hyvatia is Spacetrek Collective's first detection array built at Sundermere to monitor and stabilize the Reactor Drive's energy state in real time.

The Research Institute implanted the Exostrider's space-time error correction module runtime into Hyvatia's core, allowing Hyvatia to adjust the Exostrider's orbit and detect hidden spaceborne threats with high precision. Therefore, Hyvatia possesses sufficient computational power to predict the Reactor Drive's rotation.

Hyvatia's core function is to detect abnormal or dangerous energy fluctuations, perform immediate emergency calibrations, and feed this data back to the Drive to ensure stable operation.

After the Reactor Drive was set above Lahai-Roi by the Exostrider, it remained on high alert to the activities of Aleph-1. 

When the Drive's immune response is triggered, a mechanized "Reactor Husk" will arise from the depths of the energy well, with the sole purpose of eliminating intruders at all costs.

Research by Spacetrek Collective shows that Reactor Husk was once part of the Exostrider. Both share a mission to resist the Threnodian threat and safeguard civilization.

In ancient times, the shift in magnetic poles centered Solaris's planetary axis on Lahai-Roi. Gradually, over the ages, the cavern beneath layers of ice became home to human settlement.

In this warm, humid underground haven, the "sun" the people speak of is something else entirely. Look upward. The ██ brings here constant, unyielding daylight. Yet one question lingers in the author's heart:
If one day the ██ were to fall dark, what would become of us?

It may not be the largest cafeteria in Solaris, but it is definitely the most advanced. Every meal follows rigorous safety standards, with scientifically tailored nutritional values, ready made for long-term storage in even the harshest environments.

Popular Comment [Deleted]: Safe, refined, storable… but it just doesn't taste good.

(Fragmentary Audio Log of a short conversation)

Male Voice: (excited, breathless)
Male Voice: This lift... It's colossal! A miracle in the architectural history of Solaris. 
Male Voice: It supports the cavern's dome, linking the Academy and the Research Institute, ferrying supplies nonstop from the frostlands…
Female Voice: Typical freshman. Ride it a few more times, and you'll get used to it.

...To adapt to the vast and complex terrain of the underground haven, a new type of all-terrain vehicle was developed.

Though officially designed for research expeditions, the user manual contains no explicit rule against taking it for a joyride beyond the grounds of Startorch Academy.

Long before the Spacetrek Collective was founded, the self-sufficient nomadic Roya people had already made their home in these vast caverns. The construction of both Startorch Academy and the Research Institute would not have been possible without their help.

Drawing upon mechanical remnants of the ██, the Roya forged a settlement unlike any other. Skilled in astronomy and chronology, they are said to guard an ancient mission—awaiting the day they might repair and awaken the slumbering ██.

Do Clockatoos Dream of Electric Schedules? (Excerpt) ...The crown feathers of a Clockatoo form the hour and minute hands on a living "clock face." At fixed hours each day, it lets out a clear, piercing call. A light tap on its head will silence it. For this reason, most Roya use the Clockatoo as an "alarm-capable" timepiece and timer. Note: Bringing Clockatoos into the dormitory is strictly forbidden by the Academy.

In ancient times, It held up heaven and earth with a colossal sword; Its body nourished all life, and its blazing, deathless ██ drove back darkness from this world.

Now, upon the frozen land, it lies in silent slumber...

("After the Void Storm, the foundations of the Spacetrek Observatory were heavily damaged. Fortunately, most of the energy conversion array built on top remained functional. So the team decided to retract the foundations to prevent further wear. Once resources were sufficient, we would extend them again and begin structural repairs," says Dhalifa!)

The Suspension Platform is the Observatory's primary support and control core. Restoring it calls for no small amount of resources and effort. Let's get through it together.
("The Suspension Platform we're rebuilding won't just support the main body of the Spacetrek Observatory, it will also become the primary workspace for the researchers. Its upper level will even feature an open plaza where people can relax and enjoy the view of the Etching Plains. I can't wait to see the platform after it's fully restored," says Dhalifa!)

When the Spacetrek Observatory first began recording Lahai-Roi's ecology, climate, and landscapes, many researchers who had worked tirelessly for it broke into tears. It was our way of resisting the Void Storms that could erase even existence. And now, with your help, we stand only one step from rebuilding it. I hope you, too, will feel what we felt on that day! (So says Dhalifa!)

Now that the Spacetrek Observatory is operating again, Lahai-Roi's long-shut eyes have reopened. Everything it observes is once more captured in tangible records, streams of data flowing into the Suspension Platform like the pulse of the earth. The researchers will analyze, interpret, and archive this information to assist the Spacetrek Collective in studying Void Storm activity.

A proving ground prepared just for you—and the graveyard for the countless knights who came before. Legends say this very soil witnessed the fall of the Third Grand Commander. Now, once in a while, when the rain falls on its mechanical remains, an elegy for the valiant is sound.

It was here that the Fifth Grand Commander led the knights in a final stand. Not against a tyrannical lord, but... a Void Storm capable of obliterating all life. They failed to overcome it... or did they?
This is where it began, long before they were called the Knights of the Wild. Here, a group of Mechascouts with no way home drained their last sparks of energy to save a single child.

This land may never have heard the noble knight tales that flutter through the windmills of Egla Town. Yet the stories born are no less worthy. Let them be remembered in the rustle of the grass and the sighing winds of the emerald plains.

Machines are not born with names. Yet... if one walks through the world with the bearing of a knight, does it not deserve a name of its own? So a young man once took up his pen and inscribed their names. Astra, Caldheim, Petrahane, Airelas...
Charge, my friend! Charge! Even if your hands hold no blade, you carry one within your heart. And who is to say that a machine cannot have a heart?

The Eighteenth Grand Commander... takes the humble form of a trash can. Yet, no one ever dares toss a wrapper or a pit into its belly. Within that metallic shell lay praises written for the Knights of the Wild.

They say the Seventeenth Grand Commander was a mere human who possessed no martial prowess to speak of. Yet before the Void Storm descended, it was he who guided the knights in a desperate, wandering flight, leading them from lands doomed to be cursed. But as for his fate...

Lynae states that the results do not matter, and she's here to have a good time.

Mornye says she's quite used to hovering in the air. Her fondness for flight may well be the secret to her outstanding performance.

Mornye stated after the match that she really needed a triple-strength Instant Wakeup Energy Gel Sachet.
Mornye told us in an interview that despite not being particularly athletic, she's more than willing to demonstrate the might of the Spacetrek Collective techs.

Mornye stated that she will give it her absolute all in the final stretch of this competition.

Before the match begins, Aemeath sends her best to all Fleet Snowfluff fans, stating that she definitely won't let them down.
Aemeath thoroughly enjoyed the competition and has decided to put on a live show for the contestants and audience alike after the Final.
Aemeath credits her superhuman pace to her younger days spent chasing Snowfluff Seals.
Aemeath states that she is fully prepared for the next match. We can't wait to see her in action.
Aemeath hopes that her victory will make someone out there proud.
Inspired by her win, Aemeath is set to write a song about this competition. We can't wait to hear it!
Aemeath believes that a temporary setback is a minor inconvenience. She remains determined to prove her true strength in the Final.
What a brilliant performance! Let's give a big round of applause to Aemeath!
Luuk Herssen is in a remarkably calm and positive mindset before the match. He's stated that he simply intends to do his best.
Luuk Herssen demonstrated precise control during the match, which he attributes to the muscle memory developed from years of performing surgery.
Luuk Herssen has kindly offered medical aid and mental health support to those eliminated from the match. The event organizers extend their thanks for his generosity.
Luuk Herssen was not at all surprised by his win. But he does feel that he could have done even better.
Luuk Herssen says eating candy before a match is his secret to excellent performance.
Congratulations to Luuk Herssen on winning the Final! During his interview, he says he'll donate the prize money to children in need.
Luuk Herssen isn't disappointed with his result. He believes it was enough that he gave it his all.
Luuk Herssen is satisfied with his performance in the competition. He added that he'll likely be back for the next Derby.
Sigrika's parents sent her a good luck package before the match. To honor their expectations, she is determined to compete at her absolute best.
Sigrika is deeply grateful for everyone's support, and she has stated that she will achieve great results in the next match as well.
Sigrika states that she will redouble her efforts in the Eliminator. With the help of Soliskin, she's certain she'd win.
Sigrika says she finds this competition easy because she spends all day chasing Exoswarm.
Sigrika believes everyone who made it to the Final is incredibly strong, and that she's starting to feel the pressure...

Congratulations to Sigrika on becoming the Champion! In her interview, Sigrika thanked her family and friends in the Roya tribe, her classmates and teachers at Startorch Academy, as well as the Soliskin and Exoswarm... Let's give a round of applause for her victory!
Sigrika states that while she thoroughly enjoyed the competition, it's now time to conclude her journey with a spectacular victory.
Sigrika competed brilliantly in the Final! She's promised to keep pushing forward and is aiming for another championship next time.
Hiyuki declined our interview, stating that she would like to meditate in peace before the match.
When asked about her plans after her win in the Preliminary, Hiyuki stated that she would like to rest and eat something, preferably with a cup of fine tea.
In her interview, Hiyuki shared her daily sword practice routine. The event organizers kindly remind you: for safety reasons, please do not attempt these yourself.
Hiyuki won the Eliminator with ease. It looks like she's still holding back. You don't want to miss what she'll bring to the next match.
In her pre-Final interview, Hiyuki stated that she did not attempt to draw upon a future where she is victorious. She values the experience itself more than the outcome.
Huge congratulations to Hiyuki for coming out on top! She's dedicated to perfecting her skills and aims to create more miracles in the years to come.
Undeterred by her defeat, Hiyuki has decided to put everything on the line in the next match. Let's see what she can do!
An excellent result for Hiyuki in the Showmatch. We look forward to her performance in future Championship matches.
Denia doesn't think she has a chance of winning... She just wanted to do her best to make it to the finish line.
Denia is somewhat surprised that she wasn't eliminated in the Preliminary, though she chalks it up to a bit of luck.
We've heard from a reliable source that Denia is currently preparing for the match and is not in the locker room. Let's turn our cameras to the other contestants.
Denia has delivered another outstanding performance! She rather modestly remarked that luck was on her side again. Perhaps she really is the "chosen one" of the course!
Denia looks incredibly nervous at the starting line of the Final! Let's wait to see how the results unfold!
Denia has claimed victory in the Final! In her acceptance speech, she thanked her friends at Startorch Academy, whose support made it possible for her to reach this far.
Someone reported hearing things being smashed in Denia's locker room, but when we arrived, everything inside seemed to be fine. Maybe Denia got caught up in a video game.
Denia was outstanding in the Showmatch! She remarked that next time, she'll show us her true abilities. Can't wait to see what she's really capable of!
Chisa was reading a mystery novel an hour before the match, so the interview team decided not to bother her.
When asked about her post-match plans, Chisa said she'd be going to the Spacetrek Archive to look up some research papers.
Chisa cooked up a Lemon-Scented Sukiyaki in the locker room and shared her delicious meal with the other contestants.
Chisa notes that she knows how to find her way through a labyrinth, citing her experience in Honami City. In her view, that was the key to her success today.
Speaking after her victory, Chisa said she'd like to return to a certain cafe and hang a photo of her victory on the wall.
Congratulations to Chisa on her victory! After thanking her fellow competitors, a mysterious capybara showed up with victory snacks for her.
After reflecting on why things didn't go her way, Chisa reaffirmed her commitment to the competition. Win or lose, she won't let up on her prep work.
After winning the Showmatch, Chisa said she had a wonderful time competing alongside everyone.
When interviewed, Phrolova would not reveal her reasons for participating in the Derby and declared that her actions in cube form are not representative of her real self.
Phrolova has emerged victorious! Unfortunately, she left immediately after the match, so we were unable to complete our post-match interview.

Phrolova may not be on the best of terms with the other contestants, so the event organizers provided her with a private locker room. Melodious strains of violin can always be heard emanating from within.
Phrolova remarked that defeating her "rivals" has brought her a fleeting sense of satisfaction. She hopes to lead a climactic movement for everyone during the next match.
Phrolova says the time is ripe to bring her grand performance to its dramatic conclusion!
Phrolova has been crowned Champion! There was a flash of delight on her face before she reverted to her expressionless demeanor as if nothing had ever happened.
Phrolova vows that she will not fail a second time. She is prepared to do anything to bring this final movement to its conclusion.
Phrolova expressed her satisfaction with her final performance and offered her deepest regards to the opponents she defeated.
Augusta is fully prepared for the match and will storm the field with the force of a thunderbolt!
Augusta secured an effortless victory. It seems the competition was merely a small hunt for someone of her stature.
Augusta believes there are no shortcuts to victory. The only way to win is through relentless training and endless fighting.
Augusta is the first across the finish line! Let's give a huge cheer for yet another victory!

Augusta believes that future Agons should include elements of the Derby. It would keep certain gladiators from relying too much on Fortes and combat techniques while neglecting basic strength and endurance training.
Victory belongs to Augusta! She has nothing but high praise for the iron resolve and formidable strength shown by all participants. She looks forward to competing with them once more.
Augusta says that winning and losing are simply parts of the game. She is determined to turn the tide and secure a victory in the Showmatch.
Augusta feels she still has work to do and says she'll be back in the competition as soon as she's fully prepared.
Iuno declared that she will charge at the finish line, moonlight in arms.
Iuno claims that winning is a breeze, and the result is obvious even without a prophecy.
Iuno declined to be interviewed, saying she wanted to get a good night's sleep before the match.
Iuno is pleased with her showing. She noted that the Moonring's flight speed is still a bit on the slow side, else she would've finished even sooner.
Sticking to hunting tradition, Iuono performed a small divination ritual before the match. She's not one to blindly follow fate, but it seems to have strengthened her belief in victory.
Congratulations to Juno on her championship victory! May her glory endure forever, as timeless as the moonlight.
Iuno isn't quite pleased with her performance, but she's determined to see the competition through to the end.
Iuno has won the Showmatch. She expressed her gratitude for the audience's support and promised to do better next time.
Jinhsi states that she would not try for a better result by using her Temporal Mandate to return to the start of a match. She believes that every outcome is both precious and significant.
Jinhsi excelled in the Showmatch. She remarked that she was simply glad to have given it her all.
Changli admits that things haven't gone exactly to plan, but she believes a touch of the unexpected is more interesting than a predictable outcome.
Changli emerged victorious in the Showmatch. She hopes that by the next Derby, she will have formulated a more formidable winning strategy.
Calcharo believes that it wasn't a lack of effort on his part. There were just too many heavy hitters.
Following his victory in the Showmatch, Calcharo expressed his desire to celebrate with his Ghost Hounds.
Shorekeeper has suggested that if teleportation were allowed, her finish time would have been vastly improved.
After winning the Showmatch, Shorekeeper mentioned that she'll be reworking the office calendar so Black Shores staff have time to exercise on top of their regular duties.
Carlotta notes that victory or defeat hinges on numerous variables, including wind direction, temperature, barometric pressure, and even air humidity.
Carlotta came out on top in the Showmatch. She stated that she was well pleased with how she competed.
After careful reflection, Cartethyia eventually concluded that a wandering knight really does need a horse to go fast.
Cartethyia took the top spot in the Showmatch. She has decided to have a proper celebration after she gets back.
Phoebe believes everything is a trial of Imperator, and she accepts them all with gratitude.
Victory goes to Phoebe in the Showmatch! Phoebe chubby!

The Swift Dog is one of the common domestic dogs in families around the world, belonging to the Canidae Canis genus. It has a pointed snout, a flat forehead. The ears are high, the tail is curled up. The coat is black and yellow, the hair is coarse, and it is easy to keep clean. It has a gentle temperament, is easy to raise, and has a high degree of loyalty. It is also known as the "Four-eyed Earth Dog" in the folk. The Swift Dog is lively and cute, agile, with bright eyes, and the ears often turn with the sound.

The Bulldog is one of the common domestic dogs in families around the world, belonging to the Canidae Canis genus. It has a pointed snout and a flat forehead. Its ears are high and its tail is curled upwards. Its fur is primarily yellow or brown, and the texture is coarse, making it easy to keep clean. It has a relatively gentle temperament, is easy to raise, and has a high degree of loyalty. Bulldogs are lively and adorable, with agile movements. Their eyes are spirited, and their ears often rotate with the sound.

The Green Rabbit is a subordinate of the mammalian rabbit family Rabbitidae, and is similar to both males and females. It is small in size, with long tubular ears, short forelimbs and strong hind legs much longer than the forelimbs, greenish in color, with a Tacetite tail and a special decapitated ecology. Widespread, mostly found in plains, hills and woodlands.

The Bajorn sheep is a large herbivore belonging to the genus Bovidae, with a pair of huge horns, the tips of which are curved backward and the roots are covered with Tacetite, the lips are black, the lower jaw is white, and the body is brown. Bajorn sheep has a pair of huge horns, the tips of which are curved backward and the roots are covered with Tacetite. it has black lips, white under the jaws, brown body, huge white spots on the back, and a small amount of Tacetite at the neck. it is widely distributed in mountainous areas, and it is good at walking on steep slopes. it mainly feeds on mossy plants and small herbs.

The Gray Ridge Bull is a large herbivore belonging to the genus Bovidae. The body is stout, with a prominent bulge at the shoulder, and sparse hair, mostly gray-brown; both males and females have horns, which are short and curved inward, and covered with Tacetite. It is widely distributed in the open areas of the plains, feeding mainly on weeds and herbaceous plants beside rivers.

The Morri Cow is a large herbivore belonging to the genus Bovidae, which was domesticated by humans before the Lament and left behind in the forest after the Lament when humans gradually abandoned the Dim Forest. The Lament was originally a herbivore, but in order to adapt to the ecology of the Wuthering Waves, it began to eat Mutant Flora and its fruits, and over time the body of the Forest Cow became deformed.

Tetra biologically belongs to the carp family, the Lament after the wild, widely found in rivers and lakes on land. Tetra is a typical schooling animal, with dozens of Tetra forming a school and following the headfish to forage for food.

The Frostwing is a small bird that inhabits Tacet Field and belongs to the genus Pigeon in the family Hatydidae. The body is pure white, the tail is black and covered with Tacetite, the beak is purple, the wax membrane is magenta, and the feet and toes are bright red. It is very gregarious and often nests in groups, gathering in the stronger areas of Wuthering Waves and is widely distributed in the area around Tacet Field.

The Silver-Banded Lizard is a reptile belonging to the lizard family of the order Reptilia. It has short limbs, is agile, has leathery scales covering its body, and has black and white rings arranged on its entire body, with the white rings being narrower. It prefers a humid environment and is widely distributed on land around the world.

The Azure Lizard is a reptile belonging to the lizard family of the order Reptilia. It has short limbs, is agile, has leathery scales on its body, is blue in color, and has fleshy spines on its back. The Azure Lizard prefers moist environments, and is widely distributed in waterfronts and wetlands around the world.
The Azure Lizard has a strong ability to adapt to the environment and reproduce on its own, which is why it is the most abundant among the three species of lizards.

The Green Pit Lizard is a reptile belonging to the lizard family of the order Reptilia. It has short limbs, is agile, has leathery scales covering its body, is bright green in color, and has fleshy spines on its back. It prefers moist environments and is widely distributed in waterfronts and wetlands around the world.
The Green Pit Lizard is slightly less adaptable than the Silver-Banded Lizard, and its reproductive ability is intermediate. It is mostly found in the wild in waterside vegetation areas and along the water's edge of towns and cities.

The Black-Striped Frog is an amphibian belonging to the family Chordata, class Amphibia, order Noctuidae. It has short limbs, green body with a lot of patterns; white abdomen, slightly bulging eardrums on both sides of the head, smooth skin with warts, and a small amount of Tacetite precipitated on the back. Widely distributed in rivers, lakes, wetlands and other environments, mainly in the grass at the water's edge.

The Goldenback Frog is an amphibian belonging to the family Chordata, class Amphibia, order Noctuidae. It has short limbs, golden yellow body with a lot of patterns; white abdomen, slightly bulging eardrums on both sides of the head, smooth skin with warts, and a small amount of Tacetite precipitated on the back. It is widely distributed in rivers, lakes, wetlands and other environments, and is mainly active in grassy areas near water.
The golden-colored species is rarer and less abundant than the bright green variety, and the frog's population has declined due to habitat contamination.

The Phoenix Butterfly is a large species of the Papilionidae family, similar in size to a butterfly. It has a curved, golden-green band on each of its forewings, a few golden patches in the center of its hindwings, a crescent-shaped golden patch on the hind edge, and a long, slender, tail-like protrusion on its hindwings, the end of which is golden. It is often active in areas of dense vegetation in lush forests or other environments, flying in pairs in the high sky, feeding on nectar, and is not easily captured.
Due to its high reproductive capacity and strong adaptability to its environment, it is the most common of the three types of butterflies.

The Red Feather Butterfly belongs to the Papilionidae family, a large type of swallowtail butterfly, similar in size to a butterfly. The fore and hind wings are red, the veins are black, the wing edges have a few red spots, and the wing base has a small amount of Tacetite. They are often active in the dense vegetation of lush forests or other environments, flying in pairs in the high sky, feeding on nectar, and are not easily captured.
The Red Feather Butterfly is not as adaptable to the environment as the Phoenix Butterfly, and the population is greatly affected by changes in the environment and climate. Therefore, both its quantity and rarity are in a moderate position among the three types of butterflies.

The Blue Feather Butterfly belongs to the family Papilionidae and the genus Papilio. It is a large swallowtail butterfly, similar in size to a butterfly. The fore and hind wings are red, the veins are black, and there are a few blue spots on the edge of the wings, and a small amount of Tacetite at the base of the wings. It is often active in the dense vegetation of lush forests or other environments, flying in pairs in the high sky, feeding on nectar, and is not easy to catch. The majority of Blue Feather Butterflies are male, and the number of females is scarce, resulting in a low reproductive capacity. Therefore, the Blue Feather Butterfly is the rarest and the number is the least among the three types of butterflies.

Chrysopa belongs to the order Neuroptera and the family Chrysopidae, with a slender body shape, and the body and wing veins are generally green. It has a chewing mouthpart, slender antennae, and is linear. The compound eyes are developed and have a metallic luster. It has two pairs of wings, the membrane is transparent, the veins are thin and often net-like, like a leaf, hence the name Chrysopa. Chrysopa mainly feeds on small insects and is a natural enemy of many pests. It is a natural enemy insect with great application value in the biological control of pests. It is widely distributed in forests, mountains, and plateaus around the world, and will appear in areas with dense vegetation.

Tealfrill is a small bird with a teal body, belonging to the pigeon family. The body is teal, with a purplish-blue metallic sheen to the feathers, especially the wings, which are adorned with Tacetite. The iris is dark red, the beak is dark grey, and the toes are red. It is highly gregarious and is widely distributed in forests and ruins.

The Golden-ringed Dragonfly is an invertebrate, belonging to the order of dragonflies in the class of insects. It is overall black, with yellow patterns circling, the base of the hind wings is slightly larger than the base of the fore wings, and the wing veins are slightly different. When resting, the four wings are spread out and placed on both sides. It likes a humid environment and is often active on the riverbank or in the wetland.

The Eveflitter is a small bird that inhabits towns, belonging to the pigeon genus of the pigeon family. The feathers of the whole body are light brown, and the feathers on the top of the head are blue, hence the name blue crown. Due to the long-term consumption of the fruits of the mutated trees, a circle of Tacetite has grown on the neck. Due to the erosion, the living habits have also changed, and they are accustomed to gathering in places with stronger Wuthering Waves, and are widely distributed in major towns around the world.

The Gray Crested Gull is a large hooked-billed seabird, belonging to the order of gulls in the class of birds. The whole body is light brown, with white wing spots on the wings, and a small amount of Tacetite; the beak is black, the feathers are dark brown, and the neck and above are gray. There are many different species of the same family around the world, and they are widely distributed in the marine areas of the world.

The Snow Crane is a large wading bird, belonging to the crane genus of the crane family. The neck and feet are long, the body is mostly white, the top of the head is generally gray, the throat and neck are black, the ears to the head are white, the feet are black, the neck, tail feathers and feet are black when standing, and a small amount of Tacetite is excreted on the wings; they often act in pairs or in family groups and small groups, mainly feeding on fish and shrimp and the stems, leaves, tubers, bulbs and fruits of aquatic herbaceous plants. They are widely distributed in wetland environments.

Tricolor is one of the most common pets in families around the world, belonging to the cat family. It has a round head and a short face, with black, orange, and white colors on its body, and its fur is short and shiny. It is lively and needs a large space to move around, and is mostly found in the open areas of towns.

Lihwa is one of the most common pets in families around the world, belonging to the cat family. It has a round head and a short face, with black and gray stripes on its body, resembling a tiger's skin, and its fur is short and shiny. It is lively and needs a large space to move around, and is mostly found in the open areas of towns.

Snowwhite is one of the most common pets in families around the world, belonging to the cat family. It has a round head and a short face, with a body that is all white, and its fur is short and shiny. It is lively and needs a large space to move around, and is mostly found in the open areas of towns.

You defeated an enemy far beyond imagination, and the first sound of victory started this journey.

Variation of the Weird Sound
You met a girl named Jinhsi through the chaotic undercurrent. The rumored Dragon Lord, calm and gentle.
In the crisis of the Dim Forest, a quirky warrior extended a helping hand and claimed to form a temporary team with you.
After defeating the Tacet Discord, a little glow emerged from the deep fog pit. Danjin reunited with a familiar figure in the wonderful glow.
In the process of you absorbing power, the black hand behind the scenes is also taking action. The violent joy is leading the story to an unpredictable ending.

You wake to the voice of two girls, Yangyang and Chixia. You remember nothing of your past and know little of the present, but the abilities you display show that you are no ordinary person.

Guided by them, you begin to learn the ways of this world. When you encounter the statue of Sentinel Jué, a fragment of memory stirs, leading you toward Jinzhou City to search for the truth about yourself.

On the road, you absorb an Echo directly with your body. This unusual ability draws your new friends' attention. Chixia suggests you collect more Echoes along the way to Jinzhou City, but your second attempt fails.

With no idea how it works, you continue your journey to Jinzhou City to look for answers, unaware that a mysterious girl is watching your every step...

Your journey takes you to the City Hall, where the Magistrate of Jinzhou, Jinhsi, has summoned you. But Jinhsi is not there. Her bodyguard, Sanhua, hands you three tokens and promises a meeting in three days.
 
Yangyang urges you to seek out Huaxu Academy, where Baizhi works, for clues about the tokens. There, the first token reveals a past connection between you and Jinzhou.
 
 Your actions seem to draw many eyes. Who plays the predator, and who the prey?

The second token leads you and Yangyang to somewhere outside the city.

As you make your way out, you run into Jianxin, a young Taoist searching for a missing person. With your clearance, you bring her along past the city walls. The three of you arrive at the Midnight Rangers' Rearguard Camp, where the shadow of war looms over the horizon. Clues from the quartermaster reveal that the second token is somehow connected to the coming war.

After the matter is settled, you find yourself caught in an illusion. When you snap out of it, Yangyang's words help you realize where the final token leads: Qichi Village in the Central Plains.

When you and Yangyang reach Qichi Village, you are shocked to find it has become a Tacet Field. Your investigation is then cut short by Scar, an Overseer of the Fractsidus. He reveals the tragic events that befell Qichi Village and invites you to join him. You refuse, and the confrontation escalates into a battle.

In the chaos, a mysterious girl intervenes to cover Scar's retreat. Having gathered the information on all three tokens, you return to Jinzhou City.

With all the clues gathered, you unlock the sundial device. Hidden inside is a slip of paper pointing you to your next destination, the heavily guarded Grand Library.

As you enter the Library, Scar follows you in. But by this time, you have already met Jinhsi, and with your help, she captures Scar. From him, Jinhsi learns a shocking truth and advises you to seek an organization called the Black Shores, saying your ties to them run deep.

You find Aalto and Encore, Consultants of the Black Shores. Aalto agrees to tell you about your origins but only if you join them in investigating the Court of Savantae Ruins.

There, you discover that the Court of Savantae once tried to use an artificial Retroact Rain to trace something back in time, but the experiment failed, creating a monster. After defeating the monster, Aalto tells you that your journey once took you to the Black Shores before.

Just then, a real Retroact Rain begins to fall, and a wave of Tacet Discords strikes Jinzhou City.

Fighting alongside the people of Jinzhou, you help hold back the TD outbreak. Jinhsi confirms this was foretold by the Sentinel. With Yangyang at your side, you head to the Desorock Highland to meet Jiyan.

On the road, you are attacked by the Thundering Mephis, but Jiyan arrives just in time to help, and together you defeat the enemy. Back at the Midnight Rangers camp, you and Jiyan plan to use the Disruptor to break the Threnodian's defenses.

The Disruptor shatters the barrier protecting the Threnodian. Under the cover of your allies, you and Jiyan fight your way to the heart of the Threnodian, and together, you engage in a grueling battle against the powerful Dreamless. In the heat of battle, you unexpectedly absorb its Havoc power. As it tries to kill you, a little creature pops out of your hand and absorbs the attack, ending the crisis.

The Threnodian flees, and the dust settles. With the help of Jiyan, Yangyang, and all your allies, you manage to save Jinzhou.

Jinhsi disappears while checking on the Sentinel's safety alone. You and Changli set out for Mt. Firmament to find her.

In the mountains, time has spiraled out of control. Jinhsi refuses Jué's offer to sacrifice itself, choosing instead to fight the Sentinel as fate decrees. You witness her battle, and with your approval, Jué transfers its Temporal Mandate to Jinhsi, returning Jinzhou's future to its people.

When all is done, Jué suggests you visit the Black Shores to explore the past of you and Abby.

Data brought back from the Port City of Guixu contaminates the Tethys System and fills the Black Shores with corrupted frequencies.

The administrator of the Black Shores, Shorekeeper, reveals that you were once the Chief Steward of this place, but remains silent about the buried past... Eventually, the corruption is cleansed. With the clearance Shorekeeper returns to you, you manually reset the algorithm of the Tethys System. The lost souls trapped in the system at last find peace, and Shorekeeper regains her freedom.

Outside Panhua's Restaurant, you meet Yangyang and Chixia again. You have fully assimilated the Threnodian's power that the "little one" who now lives inside of you had absorbed.

The "little one", oblivious of its origin, turns down Chixia's suggestions for its new name, but loves the one you randomly come up: Abby. Hoping to find clues in Abby's special abilities, you discover that it cannot use them for now. You decide to consult the Sentinel and the Magistrate when you meet again.

Yangyang, Chixia, and Baizhi invite you to join them for the Moon-Chasing Festival. At the Wishing Tree, you meet Xiangli Yao and learn that he is the mysterious wish granter. You agree to help him investigate four wishes containing abnormal data.

Together, you explore the abnormal Sonoro Sphere, uncovering Xiangli Yao's past and addressing the wishers' problems. At the end of the festival, you and your friends take a commemorative photo under the moonlight.

Following the guidance from your past self and the Tethys system, you set sail for Rinascita to find Imperator and seek solutions to Abby's weakening frequencies.

Cetus the Tidebreaker attacks at sea, but Brant, captain of the Fool's Troupe, helps you through the mist. You two promise to meet again at the opening of the Carnevale.

Upon arriving in Ragunna, you see strange "pilgrimages," and a playwright steps forward to explain their origins.

Led by Acolyte Phoebe, you enter this city of Echoes and come to understand the significance of Echoes to Rinascita. While dealing with the Montelli family, who sent the invitation to the Black Shores, you resonate with an out-of-control Vitreum Dancer and receive a plea for help from the Sentinel. As you investigate the cause of this incident, you catch a glimpse of undercurrents beneath Ragunna: the secretive dealings between the Order, the nobles, and the Fractsidus. Phrolova, a Fractsidus Overseer you once met briefly, also watches from the shadows.

Gilberto has gone mad, and Lorelei of Nimbus Sanctum has fallen under the influence of the mysterious Lycoris. After helping Lorelei regain her senses, you learn that the only way to reach the Sentinel is to claim the Laurel at the Carnevale.

You work with Carlotta from the Montelli family to return the damaged Vitreum Dancer back to Averardo Vault. Clues along the journey lead to a shocking truth: Rinascita has two divinities.

Carlotta stays behind to hold off the Order's pursuers, while you make for a northern island where another secret of the Order lies hidden.

On the bridge to the island, you are attacked by the Dragon of Dirge, and Roccia of the Fool's Troupe comes to your aid. In the Penitent's End, you learn the truth behind the "pilgrimages" and regroup with Carlotta. You decide to join forces with the Fool's Troupe to win the Laurel at the Carnevale. However, Phrolova moves to disrupt the festivity.
 
After defeating her, you finally speak to the Sentinel, who tells you that "The Lost"—They wish you to help—is among the people at the Carnevale.

"The Lost" turns out to be Cartethyia, the Blessed Maiden who should have martyred herself. Together with Cantarella, head of the Fisalia family, you travel to the Avinoleum Theological Seminary to meet her.

As you explore the Seminary, Cartethyia's true origin comes to light. She is a creation of the Threnodian. She asks you to end her life once and for all, but you refuse her request.

With the help of many, the crisis is finally resolved, and Cartethyia gains a new life. In the Sentinel's final moments, They tell you the truth of history.

Cartethyia suddenly disappears, and following the clues she left behind, you arrive in Septimont, where you meet the prodigy gladiator, Lupa. To learn Cartethyia's whereabouts, you choose to team up with Lupa and win the Great Agon of Septimont. In between the events, Phrolova hands you a script and warns that Lupa will draw the Dark Tide. Meanwhile, the story of Mya seems to hint at something more… Eventually, you and Lupa win the championship, while Cartethyia fights alongside you in a way no one else can perceive.

You and Lupa head for the Central Hub. Lupa becomes frenzied and destroys its control panel. You manage to separate her from Mya, who has become a vessel of the Threnodian, and send Lupa to the beginning of the "story." There, she retrieves her lost memories and learns about Mya's fate. She then duels the Lady of the Sea and reclaims peace for Septimont. Although Cristoforo escapes Cartethyia's attack, the crisis in Septimont comes to a close, and you, Lupa, and Cartethyia finally reunite.

While searching for the residual energy of the Threnodian, you are struck into the sea by Fenrico and saved by Phrolova. To reach your goal, you decide to work with her temporarily. Inside the Sonoro she created, "the Beyond," you learn about her past, and that you once broke a promise to her.

In Fenrico's final moment, the Lantern wakes him from the Threnodian's control. He sacrifices himself to seal the gateway to the Journeying Paradise and stops the Dark Tide. But the Gem holding the Threnodian's power is taken by the Fractsidus.

Augusta invites you to join her on the hunt. But when you fight the Dark Tide entity, "the False Sovereign," an unseen force intervenes, causing the attempt to fail.

To stop the Dark Tide from spreading, you track the False Sovereign to Murmurstown. There, you and Augusta fight side by side to bring it down. The Dark Tide then subsides, and you recover the Relic of Imperator. But as you savor your victory, Cristoforo is already plotting his next move…

After the successful hunt of the False Sovereign, you discover everyone except you has forgotten about the existence of Iuno. The people attribute every one of her past deeds to you. To bring Iuno, who vanished into the moon, back to existence and rewrite her ending, you follow the guide of her bracelet and head off to the Chaos as suggested by Avidius and Lillibet. Finally, you "anchor" her amidst the Chaos and bring the unwritten future back to Septimont, and to her.

Ragunna comes under attack by the Dark Tide, its creations appearing across the city. Avidius joins you in the hunt, but during the pursuit, he gradually uncovers the truth of himself. At the end of his life, he absorbs the Dark Tide and ends the crisis in Ragunna.

It is then that you realize you have long been secretly corrupted by the Dark Tide and have now become Leviathan's Harbinger. To end the crisis once and for all, you set out for Septimont once more with the mysterious Discord Slayer Galbrena.

An abnormal High Tide strikes Septimont. To stem the Dark Tide, the people of Ragunna come to aid the city, and the Black Shores send every Bloom Bearer still able to fight. Galbrena goes headfirst into the Dark Tide. You and your companions soon follow suit and take the plunge carrying the lantern brought by Qiuyuan.
 
After all the hardship, you finally see the light of hope. You and the people of Rinascita together defeat the Threnodian revived by the Gem. Rinascita gets the peace it deserves at last.

At a tavern, you meet the traveling poet Nestor, who shares with you Ephor Augusta's stories. Before rising to power, she was an ordinary girl with no outstanding gift, yet she grew through countless trials to seize the championship and claim victory and glory. At the same time, Augusta and Iuno have readied themselves for the hunt in the Sanguis Plateaus.

As the Dark Tide closed in, at a personal request from someone in Mingting, Qiuyuan journeyed to Ragunna to your aid. After rescuing an Acolyte in Ragunna, he traveled to the Fabricatorium of the Deep, where he convinced Fenrico to yield the First Relic, a key instrument in stopping the Dark Tide. Then he arrived just in time for the final battle to deliver the Relic to you.

After the war, Ciaccona recounts Qiuyuan's deeds in Rinascita. You later find Qiuyuan at the dock as he prepares to depart, and express your gratitude.

With the chain of events at Rinascita finally concluded, you return once more to the Black Shores. Unexpectedly, the Tethys System detects a strange frequency and isolates from it a set of coordinates. As you trace the coordinates, a spatial rift leading to an unknown Sonoro Sphere tears open at sea close to the Black Shores. During the investigation, you are pulled into the rift and soon awaken in a ruined, restless city. And as the situation grows dire, a mysterious black-haired girl appears before you…

You travel to the Black Shores to visit Chisa, only to learn that during her recovery, she had secretly gone alone to Honami City. Burdened by the truth that over two decades have passed in the outside world, she feels uncertain about the future. Together, you stroll through Sakura Quarter to ease her mind. Under the falling petals, she bares her feelings to you and gives you your old student ID card along with a carefully prepared gift. To your surprise, you discover you were once a member of Startorch Academy. Chisa then suggests inviting your friends from the Black Shores to Shashou Cafe to give it a proper "opening"…

The passage to Lahai-Roi finally opens. After parting ways with Namipon and Shorekeeper, Chisa and you enter the tunnel in turn. Along the way, you are dragged into a mysterious realm inhabited by a Threnodian. Just as your frequency is about to be consumed, a pink-haired girl appears, rescues you, and sends you back to reality.
Upon reaching Lahai-Roi, you unexpectedly cross paths with a student named Lynae. She arrives on her motorbike, helps you escape an attack from a Voidworm, and brings you safely to your destination—Startorch Academy.

Once you complete the enrollment procedures, you officially become a student of Startorch Academy. At the Research Institute, you meet Professor Mornye and learn that the Spacetrek Collective is preparing for the crucial project, New Solar Ceremony. But before long, you are caught up in an incident triggered by Hyvatia's sudden malfunction. Lynae—present at the scene—becomes an immediate suspect, and together you begin to dig into the truth behind the chaos. Your investigation uncovers Lynae's hidden identity and a conspiracy orchestrated by the Fractsidus. In the end, you and Lynae lure away and defeat the Voidworm threatening the Academy, resolving the immediate danger. Yet the masterminds behind the plot remain at large, and their plans are far from over.

As the New Solar Ceremony approaches, you receive a plea for help, with its sender addressing you as Arbiter. Suspecting a link to the New Solar Ceremony, Mornye travels with you to Bjartr Woods to uncover the truth. There, you discover that the Fractsidus has deceived the Roya Tribe into triggering the Reactor Drive's fall. To ensure the successful launch of the artificial sun "Helios," Mornye enters the Drive herself. When the dust settles, a new dawn finally rises over Lahai-Roi.

After an ambush by the mysterious mech Sigillum, your frequency-loss symptoms worsen until Aemeath once again comes to your rescue. This digital ghost, visible only to you, has already died in the past, Overclocking to resonate with the Exostrider and protect Lahai-Roi. Now, to cure your symptoms and help Aemeath recover her "existence", the two of you journey to the Roya Frostlands. Along the way, you encounter Luuk Herssen. At the site where the Exostrider lies dormant, you confront and defeat Sigillum, uncovering the truth Aemeath has been hiding and witnessing her to become the savior.

After your journey to the Roya Frostlands concludes, you head to the infirmary to discuss the Exostrider plan with Luuk Herssen. In his secret workspace, he explains the current status of the Fractsidus and why he has come to Lahai-Roi. A Fractsidus member has kidnapped the Royan student who once traveled with you, taking her to the abandoned space station. Together, you work to resolve the crisis. During the mission, however, you discover that another Fractsidus agent is still hiding within the Academy, waiting for the New Solar Ceremony to begin. Comforted by Luuk Herssen's words, you accept the candy he offers, and with renewed resolve, you regain your inner peace and determination.

With the New Solar Celebration just around the corner, a game mentioned by the Grand Architect of the Fractsidus looms over the Academy like a lurking shadow. Together with Sigrika, you set out to investigate the mysterious frequency in the Dark Side and unravel the riddles surrounding it.
Working together, you manage to defeat the vortex left behind in the Dark Side, restoring a temporary calm. Yet you can't shake the feeling that more shadows are hidden, waiting beneath the peaceful facade of the evening for you to handle them.

After the New Solar Celebration concludes, Lucilla reveals that the root of the Dark Side anomaly remains unresolved. During your investigation, she discovers that the trap set by the Fractsidus specifically targets memory-type Resonators. Determined to draw the rabbit out, Lucilla volunteers to act as bait, but doing so means confronting her own vulnerabilities.
However, Lucilla has learned to face her past with honesty long ago. She breaks the illusion, and, with your help, captures the rabbit. In doing so, the root of the Dark Side anomaly is finally eliminated.

Before setting out on the mission to defend the Dimmr Plains, Hiyuki travels alone to Honami. While helping the Black Shores deal with unresolved matters about the Left Behind, she also searches for traces of the previous Miko of Flaming Sakura. There, she unexpectedly runs into the Grand Architect of the Fractsidus. Even when faced with the Grand Architect's incendiary speech, Hiyuki keeps her blade sheathed...

After the Dark Side incident, the Fractsidus's real intentions remain unclear, and the Voidmatter beneath Lahai-Roi seems to be stirring again. With the help of Lucilla, Luuk Herssen, and others, you secure a chance to speak directly with the head of the Spacetrek Collective. In the end, he gives you the green light to activate and pilot the Exostrider. The road there is anything but easy, but with the help of "everyone", you drive back Aleph-1 from deep within Voidspace and bring Aemeath home. This time, the story written across Lahai-Roi, and across the past itself, becomes one that leads toward the future: a story in which the world saves its hero.

Hiyuki raises her blade to bid farewell to the Left Behind of Honami, and to Lady Gyokuro, the former Miko of Flaming Sakura. Seeing Hiyuki's resolve, Gyokuro leaves her with one final blessing: that she no longer remain bound by fate, but step into a spring of her own as an ordinary person.

Denia, who was taken into custody after the final battle, has now woken up. The Spacetrek Collective hopes to cooperate with her and entrusts you with the negotiations. After speaking with her, you strike a bargain: she agrees to help the Collective and tell you what she knows about the Grand Architect, and in return, you spend her birthday with her at the Academy. That night, Denia finally tells you the truth about who she really is. There is no easy answer to her situation, but you speak from the heart, and that gives her the courage she needs.

[Troupe Medic Benir's Notes - R103]
 
During the examination, Roccia chose white clams, seaweed, pink salt, and filtered water to make a pot of clam soup. It turned out nice and clear, with the shells intact. Right when it was done, the clams and seaweed looked a bit like a tiny island—or maybe even a little box.
 
From the way the soup came together, it's clear Roccia's senses are sharp, her mind is calm, and that she has a strong bond with the troupe. No sign of <te href=850073>Overclocking</te> here.

P.S. Roccia had the brilliant idea of replacing the teacup assessment with a soup assessment. After all, soup is more filling, and after the examination, there's enough for everyone to have a meal. It doesn't taste too bad, either.

[Troupe Medic Benir's Notes - R103]
 
After watching Roccia on a few occasions and studying her behaviors, it seems like our first mate has a way of communicating with that strange creature, <te href=850122>Pero</te>. With Pero acting as a translator, Roccia can even talk to other <te href=850082>Echoes</te>. What's interesting is that her ability seems to be growing—at first, she needed to speak with the Echoes, but now it looks like she can communicate through frequencies.

This only started after she joined the troupe and met Pero, so I'm guessing it's some sort of resonance between them, something she picked up along the way. We'd probably call her a Non-congenital Resonator.

P.S. All this is just my best guess, though. With the tools I have, I can't pin down exactly what type she might be. There's a small chance Roccia isn't actually a Resonator, but just so happens to be able to sync up with certain frequencies. Wouldn't that still count as being a Resonator? I'll have to think on it.
